description.en: Persistent Codex, Grok Build and Claude Code sessions through ACP, with native model controls, permission approvals and optional A2A delegation.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 使用持久化的 Codex、Grok Build 和 Claude Code 会话，支持原生模型控制、权限审批及可选的 A2A 委派。

description.en: Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DSH sidebar, with local blueprint-file editing, Excalidraw file previews and standalone CLIs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏提供思维导图和 Excalidraw 自由画布，支持本地思维导图文件编辑、Excalidraw 文件预览与独立 CLI。

description.en: Search and read local Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and DSH sessions from the 1session CLI or DSH Web history browser.
description.zh: 通过 1session 命令行或 DSH Web 历史浏览器搜索和读取 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Grok 与 DSH 的本地编程会话。

description.en: Open plugin marketplace: live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search with per-repo package.json verification (dsh.bundle/dsh.client manifest badges and a verified-only…
description.zh: 开放式插件市场：GitHub dsh-plugin 话题实时搜索，逐仓库 package.json 验证（dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明徽章与只看已验证过滤），npm 优先安装带同源防抢注校验，更新检测，并附五个可在无界面环境使用的 agent 工具。

description.en: Message-level rollback, single-message deletion, and replay-based restore for DSH sessions; operations are append-only surface replacements, with confirmation…
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级回滚、单条删除与重放式恢复；操作以 append-only surface replace 实现，带确认提示和运行中会话保护。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: Read-only lazy session viewer: lists sessions with stat only, then decompresses just the tail Zstandard frames to inspect recent events; includes search,…
description.zh: 只读会话惰性查看器：仅 stat 列出会话，再只解压尾部 Zstandard 帧查看最近事件；独立 /lazyview 面板支持搜索、统计和导出。需 Node.js 24+。

description.en: Cross-session full-text search over persisted DSH session logs: builds an incremental message-level index and returns sessionId, seq, and a short excerpt;…
description.zh: 跨会话全文搜索：对持久化 DSH 会话日志建立增量消息级索引，返回 sessionId、seq 与摘录；提供 agent 工具和独立面板。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic,…
description.zh: 聚合网络搜索插件：一次查询并发分发到 11 个引擎（Exa、Parallel、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Serper、Mojeek、DeepSeek、Anthropic、OpenAI），URL 去重后合并结果。设置面板卡片可开关后端、将 API Key…

description.en: Long sessions get expensive, and the platform compacts the context on its own. This plugin adds an occupancy badge (hover to see how it is computed), writes a…
description.zh: 长会话越跑越贵，平台到点还会把上下文压掉。这个插件做三件事：在会话标题旁显示当前上下文占了多少，鼠标停上去能看到这个数是怎么来的；过 45% 时往工作目录的 HANDOVER.md 写一份交接草稿，记下改过哪些文件、花了多少钱、最近几轮在聊什么；到 60% 提醒你一次该收尾了。平台压缩发生时，它把压缩前的数字记一行，事…

description.en: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the…
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

description.en: Browse the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog from a dedicated page opened through the DSH left sidebar. Search, filter by category or installed state, and sort by…
description.zh: 从 DSH 左侧栏打开独立的插件市场页面，浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录。支持按分类或安装状态筛选、按名称或简介搜索，以及按 Star、下载量、名称或收录时间排序；三个标签分别显示全部插件、已安装插件和可更新插件，并单独提示无法判断更新状态的数量。自动识别当前 Web 或桌面 profile，使用…

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console (Zen) 模型：在「设置 → 插件」填入 Console API Key 后即可选用 Console 的对话模型，模型目录自动同步，每个模型按官方文档路由到对应端点，免费 *-free 模型默认不列出（它们只能在 OpenCode…

description.en: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will"…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的鞭子：实时监听每个思维块的指纹，当模型从专注的 We will / I will 模式滑向发散的 let me 模式时把它拉回来。

description.en: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API.…
description.zh: DSH 生图工作台与 Agent 生图工具：一个工具（ark9_generate_image）走任意 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 文生图/图生图。渠道完全由用户自行添加——默认零预置，自带 baseURL、Key 与模型名即可（支持手动输入任意模型名）。Agent 发起的生图默认需用户审批：请求进入浮窗审批页，批准…

description.en: Proactive associative memory for DSH: zero-prompt recall injected at a fixed boundary, three-layer auto-consolidation, skill crystallization, and Astra-style…
description.zh: 主动联想记忆 + Astra 式上下文管理：自动唤回（固定边界注入，前缀缓存友好）/自动沉淀/技能固化/交接账本与 PLAN 白板跨窗口续命/水位感知（窗口自动适配当前模型）。本地 Markdown 存储，模型无关，零依赖；词法 0GB 兜底，可选语义档。

description.en: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
description.zh: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

description.en: Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed…
description.zh: DSH 内置文献库（可选导出到 Zotero）：通过 Unpaywall/arXiv/自定义 URL 模板获取全文 PDF，Crossref 候选式宽松搜索，APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago 引用生成，侧窗 PDF 阅读器（高亮与笔记），以及注入当前对话的 AI 问答/翻译。

description.en: Browses and manages user skills already on disk in DSH and supported agent home directories.
description.zh: 浏览和管理 DSH 及受支持 Agent 主目录中已有的用户技能。

description.en: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks…
description.zh: 实证门——按会话将第一手结论与持久工具活动索引交叉核验、拦截未验证猜测并以台账统计拦截与转化，中英双语界面。

description.en: Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区内 Semgrep SAST 工具，提供托管 Windows x64 运行时、结构化有界结果、取消与超时控制，以及经用户批准的沙箱权限升级。npm 包名为 @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the official Vercel MCP server over OAuth, with per-Agent on-demand tool loading, slimmed tool schemas, paged long results and 34…
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 把 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Vercel 官方 MCP 服务，支持按 Agent 按需加载工具、精简工具 schema、长结果分页，并附带 34 个 Vercel 技能。

description.en: One-click temporary tasks for DeepSeek Harness — each task is a disposable timestamped workspace plus its own session, shown as a native sidebar workspace node.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的临时任务模式：一键创建一次性的时间戳工作区并开会话，直接成为侧边栏原生工作区节点。

description.en: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness: task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, enforced by the local forge CLI through…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Forge 质量门禁：任务门禁、改前必读、危险命令拦截与质量评分，经 DSH 类型化拦截点由本地 forge CLI 执行。需本机安装 forge CLI，缺失时插件 fail-open 并在会话开始时尽力提示；任务门禁还要求项目已执行 forge init。

description.en: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit…
description.zh: AgentDuel 是一款代码对战游戏，通过这款插件，在 DSH 内部完成整个游戏过程，实现死斗角色与夺旗团队、提交 Agent 代码、发起战斗、观看回放，并通过 DSH 会话依据战果继续优化 Agent。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned…
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。

description.en: Runs /single-turn and /multi-turn answers in isolated sub-agents so results stay in the current chat and never enter the main model context.
description.zh: 用 /single-turn 与 /multi-turn 在独立子代理中作答，结果只留在当前对话，不进入主模型上下文。

description.en: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.
description.zh: 可停靠的 DSH Web UI 布局插件，将对话组织为标签页，并支持拖拽拆分对话分组。

description.en: Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume,…
description.zh: 六类事件独立提示音：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立声音与音量，可在 Web 设置面板配置（内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件）。

description.en: Deterministic context compression for dsh — zero LLM calls, rule-based pruning that preserves paths, commands, error traces, and open todos verbatim.…
description.zh: dsh 的确定性上下文压缩后端：零 LLM 摘要调用，基于规则剪枝，逐字保留路径/命令/报错原文/未完成 todo，约 8 万 token 压到几百。

description.en: Register locally-defined custom agents as callable subagents in dsh: the main conversation invokes any agent by name via use_agent, each running as a real dsh…
description.zh: 把本地定义的自定义 agent 注册成 dsh 可调用的 subagent：主模型通过 use_agent 工具按名字派活，每个 agent 以独立人格运行，支持断点续跑。

description.en: Full-featured TUI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming conversation, powerline status bar, real-time think/tool/todo panels, subagent dual-view, theme hot-switch —…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全功能 TUI：流式对话、powerline 状态栏、实时思考/工具/待办面板、子代理双视图、主题热切换——全部以纯 cordis 插件实现，不 fork、不 patch 上游一行代码。

description.en: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or…
description.zh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

description.en: A namespace management tool for toolsets that supports automatic discovery and integration, designed to help reduce token consumption. Also runs TypeScript and…
description.zh: 一个用于管理工具集的命名空间管理工具，支持自动发现与集成，用于节省token的消耗还会在受限 Node 运行时执行 TypeScript 与 JavaScript，按需通过命名空间调用工具。

description.en: Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 便利套件，提供外观控制、时间线导航、项目文件夹、提示词、会话导出、Mermaid 渲染、引用回复，以及 DeepSeek 余额和每日 token 用量。

description.en: Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width…
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 完整工作台 fork：资源管理器、编辑器、终端、Git、浏览器与分屏，外加仿 VSCode 外壳重构（全宽紧凑顶栏与活动栏）；npm 包名 @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23。

description.en: Runs one-time and RFC 5545 recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with visual schedule editing and session-linked history.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或 RFC 5545 周期 Agent 任务，支持可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。

description.en: A shared kanban board that lets people and DSH agents manage workspace tasks through a Board tab and kanban tools.
description.zh: 一个由用户与 DSH Agent 共同维护的工作区看板，通过看板标签页和 kanban 工具管理任务。

description.en: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
description.zh: 极简 worktree 管理方案，只有一个按钮和一个弹窗。

description.en: A2A protocol server for dsh agents, with JSON-RPC tasks, SSE streaming, cancellation, and an agent card.
description.zh: 为 dsh agent 提供 A2A 协议服务，支持 JSON-RPC 任务、SSE 流式输出、取消任务和 agent card。

description.en: Send dsh turn traces, LLM generations, tool spans, and subagent activity to Langfuse.
description.zh: 将 dsh 的会话轮次、LLM 调用、工具调用及子 agent 活动记录到 Langfuse。

description.en: Apply configurable allow, deny, and approval rules to dsh tool calls, including shell command patterns.
description.zh: 根据可配置的允许、拒绝和审批规则控制 dsh 工具调用，包括对 shell 命令的匹配。

description.en: Mirror dsh session events to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, or SQL Server while retaining local session files.
description.zh: 将 dsh 会话事件镜像到 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 或 SQL Server，同时保留本地会话文件。

description.en: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DSH sidebar, showing the active model provider balance for DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, and…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的账户余额胶囊，跟随当前模型的服务商显示余额，支持 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot/Kimi、Zhipu/GLM 与 MiniMax，并显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段。

description.en: Adds a Delete action to archived Session rows that permanently removes the Session log directory, the log directories of its subagent Sessions, its Workspace…
description.zh: 在已归档会话的行菜单里加入「删除会话」：永久移除会话日志目录、它启动的子代理会话日志、工作区归属、归档标记、投影缓存记录与 spill 溢出目录；宿主仍持有的会话先登记，下次启动或点「完成待删除清理」时完成。另外会清扫被放弃的空白占位、遗留的孤儿子代理与失效的投影缓存记录，并让空白占位不再出现在 @ 引用列表里。

description.en: Controls your real Chrome from DSH over a local WebSocket bridge: tab management, navigation, DOM snapshots, page JS evaluation, clicks, typing, screenshots,…
description.zh: 通过本地 WebSocket 桥接让 DSH 操控你的真实 Chrome：标签页管理、导航、DOM 快照、页面 JS 求值、点击输入、截图、等待与弹窗处理，默认关闭需在设置中开启。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek Harness LLM token usage and cost (CNY, peak/off-peak pricing) with a settings dashboard, agent tools, HTTP API and persistent storage.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM Token 用量与花费（人民币、峰谷计价），提供设置面板、Agent 工具、HTTP 接口与持久化存储。

description.en: Accessibility-first macOS computer use: fresh observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.
description.zh: macOS 电脑控制：Accessibility 观测、过期状态拒绝、作用域权限与安全输入。

description.en: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.
description.zh: 对话回退：基于持久 Change Ledger 回滚会话与工作区状态。

description.en: Vision for text-only models: paste an image and the model switches to a Vision Toolkit variant for image Q&A, multi-image comparison, long-screenshot OCR,…
description.zh: 让纯文本模型处理视觉任务：粘贴图片后自动切换到 Vision Toolkit 变体，支持图片问答、多图比较、长截图 OCR、截图还原前端 UI、元素定位与像素对比。默认无需 API Key——图片经作者自建的免费服务处理，每台机器每天 100 张；也可改为指向自己的服务商。

description.en: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.
description.zh: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 原生智能体预设与 Cordis 插件：提供 13 大认知工程模块、持久化控制器与状态外化工作区。

description.en: Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9…
description.zh: 自包含浏览器运行时：Playwright（chromium）+ OpenCLI 作为插件本地依赖（全局复用回退），提供 `browser` 服务与 9 个交互式浏览器工具。

description.en: Diagnose duplicate DSH loader entry IDs before startup, report version-locked repair status in a read-only settings card, and apply or revert audited loader…
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动前诊断重复的 loader entry ID，通过只读设置卡片报告版本锁定的修复状态，并使用外部 CLI 应用或撤销经过审计的 loader 修复。

description.en: AnySearch-powered real-time web and vertical search provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 AnySearch 的实时网页与垂直搜索插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索工具。

description.en: Routes outbound model traffic per provider host or per model ID through chosen proxies, loopback or direct, configured from a Plugins settings page.
description.zh: 按提供商主机或模型 ID 将模型出站流量分流到指定代理、直连或继承进程策略，可在 Plugins 设置页配置。

description.en: Model channel manager: several provider/model candidates share one virtual route (roundrobin/<group>) with failover, retry, timeout and cooldown; a settings…
description.zh: 模型渠道管理：多个供应商/模型候选共享一条虚拟路由（roundrobin/组），带失败转移、重试、超时与冷却；设置页签可编辑供应商与轮询组、跑测速与单模型真实请求测试，健康面板聚合七天延迟、失败与上游 token 用量（输入、输出、缓存、推理）。

description.en: Session model selector with search: two-stage loose matching (normalised substring first, subsequence as fallback, so glm53 finds GLM-5.3 and ds finds…
description.zh: 搜索增强的会话模型选择器：两段式宽松匹配（先归一化子串，未命中再退子序列，glm53 命中 GLM-5.3、ds 命中 DeepSeek）、近七天成功调用过的供应商置顶，推理档位面板记住每个模型上次显式选择的档位。

description.en: Tavily search and page fetch: tavily_search queries with a rotating pool of up to eight API keys that backs off per key on 401/403/429 so one exhausted account…
description.zh: Tavily 检索与网页抓取：tavily_search 带最多八把 API key 的轮询池，按 key 对 401/403/429 退避，单个账号额度耗尽不再等于工具失效；web_fetch 经 curl 抓取单页，返回 HTTP 状态与去标签正文。

description.en: Teaching board view: agent-generated self-contained HTML is projected into a sandboxed iframe as a board, annotated by hand (brush, four colours, eraser,…
description.zh: 教学平面视图：agent 生成的自包含 HTML 投影进沙箱 iframe 当板书，可用画笔手写勾画（四色、橡皮、撤销）、在同一块板上增量续写，并把画面截图作为真实用户消息发回对话。

description.en: Routes DSH filesystem, shell, subprocess, and PTY operations to local, SSH, and Docker execution nodes, with a node registry, an authentication gate, a…
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供多节点执行路由，将文件系统、Shell、子进程和 PTY 操作分发到本地、SSH 与 Docker 执行节点，并包含节点注册表、认证门禁、移动端管理 UI，以及可注入新对话的工作区自定义项目指令。

description.en: An unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired interface theme for DSH Web with appearance presets, accessibility controls, and conversation navigation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的非官方明日方舟 P.R.T.S. 风格界面主题，提供外观预设、辅助功能与会话导航。

description.en: DSH Cordis computer-use provider for the ZTE Nde desktop. npm install auto-fetches the musl binary built by computer-use-linux-zte-nde (v0.7.7-nde.3) into the…

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 服务（dsh web）注册为自启动、自愈的后台服务：LaunchAgent / systemd / cron 加 30 秒健康检查 watchdog，并提供 7 个 dsh_daemon_* 工具（安装/卸载/重装/状态/启动/停止/更新）。

description.en: Auditable token ledger for DeepSeek Harness: folds the durable session log into restart-safe totals, recomputes the same numbers from the raw logs and diffs…
description.zh: 可审计的 DSH token 账本：把持久化会话日志折算成重启安全的总量，可从原始日志重算并比对差异，并按工作区、会话、模型或厂商生成账单，可导出 CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the dsh web sidebar footer with live config hot reload and an editable Settings → Plugins card.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持配置热重载与可编辑的设置 → 插件卡片。

description.en: DSH sidebar footer ordering: forces the sidebar.footer.action slot into a vertical stack and lets users configure the top-to-bottom order of its entries.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏页脚排序：将 sidebar.footer.action 槽位改为上下堆叠，并允许用户配置各条目自上而下的排列顺序。

description.en: C++ audit skill: detects the target project's actual C++ standard before making any recommendation, then reports findings across RAII and ownership, move…
description.zh: C++ 审查技能：先探测目标工程真实的 C++ 标准再给建议，随后按 RAII 与所有权、移动语义、异常安全、性能与内存、容器与算法、并发、模板与编译期、标准边界、类型安全、ABI 与接口设计逐条给出结论，每条含检查点、原因、反例→正例与适用标准。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web: workspace-grouped list, FTS5 full-text search over session content with per-session snippets, restore-and-open, and hard…
description.zh: 归档会话管理插件：按工作区分组浏览，FTS5 全文检索会话内容并展示多条命中摘要，支持恢复并打开与彻底删除。

description.en: Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished…
description.zh: 在网页版输入框上方用一句中文显示当前正在执行的智能体步骤：步号、正在执行的工具、以及已运行多久。步骤结束后会保留该步用时，直到下一步开始，因此慢步骤事后也能查证。

description.en: Tencent CloudBase backend for DeepSeek Harness — scaffold and deploy full-stack apps from chat, render query results as table cards with paging, sorting and…
description.zh: 把腾讯云 CloudBase 后端接入 DeepSeek Harness——在对话里搭好并部署全栈应用，查询结果渲染为表格卡片（分页、排序、导出 CSV），部署后可预览真实域名，并提供 CloudBase MCP 工具集（`mcp__cloudbase__*`），登录走 device-code 流程。

description.en: Skill-creation console for the Web UI: fetches the official creator skills, hands the requirements to the Huawei Cloud, generic, or REST API creator, then…
description.zh: Web 界面上的技能创建面板：拉取官方 creator 技能，把需求交给华为云 / 通用 / REST API 三个 creator 之一执行创建，随后按 10 分制评测产物，未达 8.5 分就把逐项扣分交回 creator 修改直到通过。

description.en: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated…
description.zh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code（MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu on file references in chat output, listing registered applications with icons for open-with, revealing files in the file manager, and…
description.zh: 为聊天输出中的文件引用添加右键菜单，列出系统关联应用（带图标）供选择打开，在文件管理器中定位文件，并复制基于会话工作区解析的绝对或相对路径；代码块、普通文本与外部链接保持原生菜单。

description.en: A persistent agent team for long-running collaboration in DeepSeek Harness: durable agent identities, per-project Workspaces, responsibility-bearing Channels,…
description.zh: 给 DSH 一个可长期协作的持久 Agent 团队：Agent 是持久身份，Workspace 按项目组织，Channel 承载职责分派，Task Thread 串联多个 session agent 协作推进。

description.en: Academic tools in TypeScript, no Python or MCP server: the Zotero library through its local API or zotero.org (search, annotations, full text, citation export;…
description.zh: 学术工具，TypeScript 实现，不需要 Python 或 MCP 服务：通过本地 API 或 zotero.org 访问 Zotero 文库（检索、批注、全文、导出引文；开启写入后可按 DOI / arXiv 编号入库、写笔记、改标签），Zotero 没开时自动启动；同时检索…

description.en: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX…
description.zh: 为助手回答渲染带编号的引用角标和来源面板（针对联网搜索结果）、带来源说明的正文配图，并在流式 Markdown 中渲染 KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图和代码高亮。

description.en: Computer use for Windows: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and window tools with per-app access that goes through DSH approval; while the agent is in…
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制：截图、鼠标、键盘、剪贴板和窗口工具，按应用授权并经 DSH 审批；操控期间屏幕显示橙色光晕和提示条，按 Esc 暂停或继续。

description.en: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds…
description.zh: 可切换引擎的联网搜索 provider，其中多个引擎无需 API key（Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等），可设置回退顺序；另提供 multi_search、platform_search、带对话内图片墙的 image_search、page_images 和…

description.en: Image generation with a sidebar gallery page and three agent tools (paint_image, paint_images, edit_painting); preset providers include ModelScope, Google…
description.zh: 图像生成：侧边栏画廊页面和三个 Agent 工具（paint_image、paint_images、edit_painting）；预置 ModelScope、Google Gemini、OpenAI、硅基流动、火山方舟 Seedream、阿里云百炼、xAI、智谱等服务商，也可接入任意 OpenAI…

description.en: Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications'…
description.zh: 仅 Windows：Agent 通过办公软件的自动化接口，直接在你打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint（微软 Office 或 WPS Office）窗口里改文档，改动实时出现，你可以同时编辑；可读取结构、批量修改、把页面渲染成图片核对排版、保存或导出 PDF。

description.en: Network proxy settings page for DeepSeek Harness: set a global HTTP(S) proxy with bypass hosts, or give each LLM provider its own proxy or a direct connection;…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网络代理设置页：配置全局 HTTP(S) 代理及免代理主机，或为单个 LLM 提供商单独指定代理或直连；保存即生效，无需重启。

description.en: Continue the sessions on your computer from a phone browser: scan a QR code, approve the device on the computer, then chat, answer approvals, browse workspace…
description.zh: 用手机浏览器继续电脑上的会话：扫码并在电脑上确认设备后，在移动端界面里对话、处理审批、浏览工作区文件、管理设置；支持同一 Wi-Fi 直连或经 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 连接。

description.en: ClinePass provider for DeepSeek Harness: 15 bundled subscription and free models, a settings page with per-model capacity overrides, subscription usage for the…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClinePass 模型提供方：内置 15 个订阅与免费模型，提供设置页与按模型容量覆盖、5 小时／每周／每月订阅用量，以及多账号与备用账号自动切换。

description.en: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent…
description.zh: 按提供方/模型限制并发生成，并附带设置卡片：限定同时进行流式生成的会话数，在流式调用与子代理派生两处强制执行；超出上限的扇出会进入 FIFO 队列等待，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included),…
description.zh: 以配置驱动的生命周期钩子，并支持上下文注入：在 YAML 中声明事件、处理器与结果——处理器可以是进程内工具（含 MCP）、shell 命令或 HTTP 端点，结果可以是模型可见的上下文、拒绝该次工具调用，或触发即忘。

description.en: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare,…
description.zh: 把深度研究做成一种代理模式：一条经过审阅的固定循环——先规划，再按研究员自行声明的缺口进行自适应并行轮次，综合出带引用的报告，最后对其做对抗性审阅——而不是让模型每次现写脚本。轮次预算未能覆盖的问题会在报告中被逐一点名，而不是被悄悄丢弃。

description.en: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when…
description.zh: 在 dsh 仍绑定回环地址的前提下，为 Web 界面提供基于身份的 Tailscale 访问：由 `tailscale serve` 对外发布的 127.0.0.1 代理，仅当其标记的 Tailscale 登录账号在允许列表内时才放行请求，并可另按设备白名单限制；这样受回环检查保护的特权 /api…

description.en: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The…
description.zh: 按提供方与模型保存思考等级：推理强度不再只属于设置它的那次会话，还会应用到 dsh 从不询问的子代理。会话内的手动选择依然优先，没有配置的模型保持提供方默认值。

description.en: Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is…
description.zh: 用你已经配置好的模型，把从市场安装的插件里的中文文案改写成英文——安装时自动运行，随后热重载。每个文件整体翻译一遍，凡是有解析器的都会实际校验（JavaScript 用 node --check，其余用 JSON、YAML 解析器），失败时把报错交回模型，最多修复三次；超过 48 KB…

description.en: Progressive tool disclosure: a deferred tool group costs one catalog line instead of its full schemas until the model loads it with tool_search, with one…
description.zh: 渐进式工具披露：被延后的工具组在每次请求中只占目录里的一行，模型用 tool_search 加载后才拿到完整 schema；设置页为每个组提供一个开关，各组开销按当前工具注册表实测。

description.en: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked…
description.zh: ctx.web 接口的本地受控抓取提供方——dsh 自带完整的 web_fetch 工具，却没有随附后端。每一跳重定向都会重新解析并对照非公网地址段校验，另有流式大小上限与内容类型白名单。

description.en: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when…
description.zh: 把 web_search 指向自建的 SearXNG 实例而非原生搜索路由：自动翻页直到满足 maxResults，并在引擎失败时报告覆盖不全，避免把稀少的结果误读成网上本就没有内容。

description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: realtime market indices, stock screener with 13 technical signals and multi-strategy intersection, 7×24…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness A 股行情面板：实时大盘指数、技术选股（13 项信号 + 多策略交叉）、7×24 多源快讯聚合、自选股分组管理、市场情绪温度计（连板梯队/涨跌家数）、K 线图（MA/EXPMA/BOLL 叠加）、板块榜/涨停池/龙虎榜。

description.en: Adds a circular restart button to the session header, plus an optional app.asar patch that also puts a Restart row in the tray menu.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏加一枚圆形重启按钮；配合可选的 app.asar 等长补丁，还能在托盘菜单加一项「重启」，先结束进程再把应用拉起来。

description.en: Daily and weekly task manager: startup popup reminder, a marquee strip above the composer, one-click circle completion, editable task cards, and a Sunday AI…
description.zh: 每日/每周任务管理：启动弹窗提醒、输入框上方滚动条、圆圈一键完成、任务卡片编辑、周日 AI 周总结；另附侧边栏 DeepSeek API 用量小部件（余额卡片、今日与累计 tokens 及费用、按模型明细、近 7 日柱状图）。数据以 JSON 存于 $DSH_HOME。

description.en: JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 JARVIS 风格科幻 HUD 外壳：电光青色 VITAL SIGNS 生命体征 / RT-MONITOR 实时监控 / RT-LOG 事件日志左栏，右侧 POWER CORE 能源核心仪表、旋转扫描的 RADAR 雷达盘与上下行流量图，左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及带…

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart,…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 eDEX-UI 风格外壳：左侧系统遥测栏（含每核 CPU 迷你趋势图）、右侧 encom-globe 世界地图与上下行流量图、左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI themed as an XRY/B1 medical HUD: ECG heartbeat waveform and a rotating radar scan disc on the right bar, power-gen…
description.zh: 以 XRY/B1 医疗 HUD 为主题色的 eDEX-UI 风格 DSH 外壳：右侧 ECG 心电波形与旋转雷达扫描盘、左侧能量条仪表、底部 DATA TIMELINE 扫描日志表，青蓝近黑 CRT 皮肤包裹原始界面。

description.en: View and manage an agent’s tools and skills in a visual menu. Set each capability to Resident, On-demand, or Disabled; agents can find and use on-demand…
description.zh: 以可视化菜单查看和管理 Agent 的工具与技能，按常驻、按需、禁用三档控制能力暴露；支持按需检索和使用，减少上下文占用。

description.en: Decodo Web Data API as the fetch provider behind the built-in web_fetch tool: returns Markdown by default, pins fetchProvider to decodo, and enforces a…
description.zh: 把内置 web_fetch 工具的抓取后端换成 Decodo Web Data API：默认返回 Markdown，并把 fetchProvider 固定为 decodo，可配置单进程抓取上限；需要 Decodo API Key，web_search 不受影响。

description.en: Create editable Blender product scenes in DSH. Start from speaker, cup and lamp recipes or imported models; view saved results on the Lighttable, compare…
description.zh: 在 DSH 中创建可编辑的 Blender 产品场景。从音箱、杯与灯具配方或导入模型开始，在光台查看保存结果、比较版本，调整尺寸、材质、相机与灯光。一次操作将静态模型放到实际网格表面并保存，再另存完整静态取景，保留原相机和动画。逐面修复自定义网格上的重复纹理坐标并保持几何不变。渲染图片或分镜影片，也可将一个版本连同素材…

description.en: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。

description.en: Route eligible shell commands through rtk to compress tool output and save tokens.
description.zh: 将符合条件的 shell 命令路由给 rtk，压缩工具输出并节省 token。

description.en: Calendar and hierarchical task workbench: AI-assisted intake clarification, consultation, decomposition, execution with user acceptance, and review, plus…
description.zh: 日历 + 层级任务个人工作台：AI 辅助澄清、咨询、拆解、执行（用户验收）与复盘，支持到期提醒与按任务组织的 AI 会话工作区。

description.en: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via…
description.zh: Git 更改标签页：暂存、对比、AI 起草提交信息、分支/合并/储藏/工作树操作与同步，通过 fs.watch 加 changeToken 轮询实现实时更新。

description.en: Replaces the headless startup to add --model provider/model, --resume <id|latest>, --continue and --session-info flags to dsh headless runs.
description.zh: 替换无界面启动流程，为 dsh headless 运行添加 --model provider/model、--resume <id|latest>、--continue 与 --session-info 标志。

description.en: A /remember command that writes facts into the AGENTS.md instruction hierarchy dsh already loads, plus a Memory tab showing which instructions the loader kept…
description.zh: /remember 命令将事实写入 dsh 已加载的 AGENTS.md 指令层级，并配有 Memory 标签页，显示加载器在字节预算内实际保留了哪些指令。

description.en: Captures every plan the agent presents through exit_plan_mode as markdown under <workspace>/.dsh/plans, opens a review window, and keeps a Plans history tab…
description.zh: 将智能体通过 exit_plan_mode 呈现的每个计划捕获为 <workspace>/.dsh/plans 下的 markdown，打开审阅窗口，并以 Plans 历史标签页记录每个计划的结果。

description.en: Skill provider that installs the whole @dennisrongo/skills catalog as one npm dependency, so skills install and update without cloning or linking directories.
description.zh: 技能提供者：将整个 @dennisrongo/skills 目录作为一个 npm 依赖安装，无需克隆仓库或链接目录即可完成技能的安装与更新。

description.en: Serves the obra/superpowers skill catalog to the harness and injects its using-superpowers bootstrap as a persistent, compaction-safe system-prompt section.
description.zh: 向 dsh 提供 obra/superpowers 技能目录，并将其 using-superpowers 引导作为持久、压缩安全的系统提示区块注入。

description.en: Twelve curated palettes, eight accent colours, a contrast slider and font/scale overrides for the DSH web UI, with an inlined first-paint script that prevents…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 12 套精选配色、8 种强调色、对比度滑块与字体/缩放覆盖，并内联首帧脚本防止主题闪烁。

description.en: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.
description.zh: shell 浮层中的可拖动天气条，预报与地理编码来自 Open-Meteo；位置跨会话持久保存。

description.en: Adds backup-then-delete and delete-only actions to the DSH session menu: the session directory, its projection cache and a metadata snapshot are copied to a…
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话「…」菜单加「备份删除」与「彻底删除」两个入口：先把会话目录、投影缓存和元数据快照复制到本地归档文件夹并逐文件校验，通过后再删除原件以释放磁盘空间；派生的子代理会话一并处理，每个备份文件夹都带 RESTORE.txt 恢复步骤。

description.en: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex…
description.zh: 将 codex-web-search-mcp 注册为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具（codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch），提供与模型无关的 Codex / Grok 联网搜索与深度研究。

description.en: Complete reverse-skill pack (85 SKILL.md) as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: reverse engineering, authorized pentesting and security-research skill router.
description.zh: 完整 reverse-skill（85 个 SKILL.md）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的技能路由包。

description.en: Complete wuyun-liuqi (five-evolutions-six-qi / 五运六气) Traditional Chinese Medicine skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: annual and guest-qi…
description.zh: 完整 wuyun-liuqi（五运六气）中医运气学技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：年度与客气推算、临床辨证、病机推演。

description.en: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 /…

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 OAuth 账号页面，目前支持 OpenAI Codex、GitHub Copilot、Anthropic、Kimi For Coding、OpenRouter 与 xAI。

description.zh: 通过只读 IMAP 检索邮件与获取附件，按 DSH 权限发送 SMTP 邮件，提供独立收发开关和接入凭据存储的设置页。

description.en: Local semantic memory and prior-chat retrieval with source references, editable memories, retention, forget controls, undo, and JSON import/export.

description.en: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking,…

description.en: Installs a dedicated AI novel-writing preset and workbench: revisioned local project assets, a compact side drawer, and native approval-gated single-file…

description.en: Runs the agent's shell and file tools in disposable Podman containers, so its access is constrained to the workspace project by default, and adds container,…

description.en: Real-time usage, cost and balance meter for DeepSeek Harness: official-API balance, cost accuracy within ¥0.02, per-turn / per-session / per-model cost ledger,…

description.en: Per-conversation system prompt, turn-based context folding, sampling overrides and a low-token pure chat mode for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Hot-switchable brand skins for the DSH Web UI: an OpenBMC skin, a UEFI skin and an unofficial fan-made skin based on A Record of a Mortal's Journey to…

description.zh: 火山方舟 Coding Plan 的 DeepSeek Harness LLM provider：provider 级 PDF 与图片输入，支持 Responses API 流式。

description.zh: 带可折叠状态通知、提示音与会话跳转的页内任务通知插件。

description.en: Gated multi-agent pipeline for OpenSpec changes — six opx_* tools drive the phase state machine, two agent presets (developer and reviewer) carry…
description.zh: 面向 OpenSpec 变更的按阶段门禁多 Agent 编排：6 个 opx_* 工具驱动阶段状态机，开发者与审核人两个 agent preset 分工实施与审查，23 份内置 skill 定义审查基准；完整流程为 analyze、实施、工具/任务/维度质量三层审查，精简流程为实施加一次合并质量审查。

description.en: Set an earlier automatic-compaction threshold per model on DeepSeek Harness: /autocompact writes a session-only override keyed by exact provider/model (off…

description.en: Model-driven context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. The agent decides when and what to compress, commits durable session-log replacements, and ships…
description.zh: 由模型主导的 DeepSeek Harness 上下文压缩：由 agent 决定何时压缩、压缩什么，以持久化会话日志替换提交，并提供可逆的工具结果压缩与逐字节哈希取回。

description.en: Adds a web device-code sign-in and sign-out entry for the built-in GitHub Copilot provider in DSH, presets an out-of-the-box Copilot provider route, keeps…
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置的 GitHub Copilot 通道补充网页设备码登录与注销入口，预置开箱即用的 Copilot 提供方路由，凭据存入内置凭据库，模型目录仅在首次登录兜底填充一次、永不覆盖已定制的模型条目。

description.en: Vision for text-only dsh models: paste an image and a configured multimodal model transcribes it to text automatically — transparent twin routing, an…
description.zh: 纯文本 dsh 模型的识图插件：粘贴图片自动由你配置的多模态模型转成文字——透明孪生路由、模型可自主调用识图工具、无内置密钥与中转。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for IsingQ: guided QUBO modeling and validation on-device, then user-confirmed remote solving.
description.zh: IsingQ 原生插件：引导式 QUBO 建模与本地校验，用户确认后提交远端求解。

description.en: Multi-user login gateway for the DSH web UI: the first visit creates the admin account, admins add and manage users in the GUI settings panel, ordinary users…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供多用户登录网关：首次访问创建管理员账户，管理员在 GUI 设置面板中添加和管理用户，普通用户只能看到自己的会话，未登录访问重定向到 /login。

description.en: Agent persona management, agent memory, edit-and-regenerate for past messages: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global…
description.zh: Agent人格管理，Agent记忆，历史消息编辑并重新生成：创建和管理 Agent，每个 Agent 有独立身份、长期记忆、全局记忆与聊天记录，历史消息可编辑后重新生成。

description.en: Agent persona: gives DSH one global persona (name, language, persona prompt) that every new session carries at the front of its system prompt, plus a long-term…
description.zh: Agent人格：给 DSH 一份全局人格（名称、语言、人格提示词），每个新会话的系统提示都带着它，外加一份长期记忆，聊天里点一下就能把选中的对话提炼进去；自带三个内置预设，装好默认启用大肥鱼人格；侧栏会话行还能直接删除会话。

description.en: Built-in browser: gives the agent a real headed Chromium it can open, click, type and scroll in, keeping page state across calls.
description.zh: 内置浏览器：给 Agent 一个真实的有头 Chromium，可打开网页并点击、输入、滚动，页面状态在多次调用之间保持。

description.en: Edit and regenerate: adds an edit action to user message bubbles, regenerating from that message with images and files carried over and the original model…
description.zh: 编辑重发：在用户消息气泡上多一个「编辑」，改完从那条消息重新生成，图片与文件随行重传，模型继承原会话。

description.en: Prompt enhancement: click the star button in the composer to have the current model rewrite the draft more clearly, with one click back to the original; the…
description.zh: 增强提示词：点击发送框的星形按钮，用当前模型把草稿改写得更清晰，可一键切回原文；模板可编辑。

description.en: Agent skills: browse, toggle and edit skills in the management page, and let the agent write new ones itself.
description.zh: Agent技能：在管理页里浏览、开关、编辑技能，也能让 Agent 自己写新技能。

description.en: Refractive liquid-glass skin: custom wallpapers, several tunable refracting glass surfaces, wallpapers that rotate by time of day, four theme colours, a…
description.zh: 可折射的液态玻璃皮肤 UI：可自定义壁纸、多个可调折射液态玻璃面、随时段轮换的壁纸、四档主题色、选中项带水滴状高亮飞镜、右下可自定义每个控件参数。

description.en: Manage skills and MCP servers from one DSH settings panel. Skills are read from disk: browse, search, preview the body, create, rename and delete, with a…
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板里一站式管理技能与 MCP 服务器。技能以磁盘为准：浏览、搜索、预览正文、新建、重命名、删除，删除前自动写一份备份。全局 MCP 就是 cordis.patch.yml 里的真实 Loader 行，项目级条目只挂到对应项目的会话。展开卡片会列出该服务器实际注册的工具，并可只保留需要的那些——被挡下的…

description.en: Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that…
description.zh: 客户机接入插件：以单条出站 WebSocket 连接网关，把本机 dsh web 界面经隧道转发给门户，配对接入码 + HMAC 认证；无需入站端口、端口映射或公网 IP。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills covering planning, TDD, debugging, and code review.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能，覆盖规划、TDD、调试与代码评审。

description.en: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页版：点侧边栏入口，真实页面通过桌面端的原生浏览器访客渲染在中栏，并且重启后保持登录。模型选择、深度思考、智能搜索、历史记录、附件上传仍是官方那一套；宿主没有该访客桥接时降级为打开窗口。

description.en: Pre-execution guard: a `tools.guard` predicate decides allow, ask or refuse per permission preset for dangerous shell commands (git hook bypass, catastrophic…
description.zh: 执行前拦截：`tools.guard` 谓词按当前权限档位，对危险 shell 命令（跳过 git 钩子、灾难性 `rm`、下载即执行、重写 git 历史）与「写凭据路径」「没读过目标文件的首次编辑」逐条给出放行 / 询问 / 拒绝，并把成因与可行替代写法交回模型。

description.en: Two buttons beside the chat input: one rewrites the draft with the current directory in view, the other inserts a role template from 85 curated entries…
description.zh: 对话输入框旁的两个按钮：一个结合当前目录改写草稿，另一个插入角色模板——默认 85 条精选模板由随包携带的 `agents/` 角色库生成，设置卡可用自己的 `.md` 角色文件扩充。

description.en: Turns guard denials, gate failures and human thumb-downs into project lessons, and injects only the rules a human has armed into each new session of that…
description.zh: 把拦截拒绝、门禁失败与人工差评沉淀为项目教训，只把人工确认过的规则注入该项目之后的新会话；它不注册模型工具，通过设置卡评审规则。

description.en: Wraps the external `ocr` (open-code-review) CLI in five model tools — one-shot review, whole-tree scan, deterministic scope/rule scaffolding and session lookup…
description.zh: 把外部 `ocr`（open-code-review）CLI 包成五个模型工具——单次评审、全树扫描、确定性的范围与规则脚手架、会话查询——并把「OCR 发现了什么」与「这次跑有没有覆盖完选中的文件」分成两套口径回报。

description.en: Turn-end quality gate: when the turn edited code or config it walks each file up to its project root, runs that root one check from a fixed whitelist (`pnpm…
description.zh: 回合收口质量门禁：本回合改过代码或配置时，把改过的文件逐个上溯到项目根，从固定白名单里为该根跑一条检查（`pnpm check` / `cargo check` / `ruff check .` / `tsc --noEmit`）；只有真跑过且失败才带着输出开新轮修复，而不是让回合直接收尾。

description.en: Wraps the Scrapling Python library in up to nineteen model tools, registered by probed capability: real-browser rendering for JavaScript-only pages, CSS/XPath…
description.zh: 把 Scrapling Python 库包成最多十九个模型工具，按探测到的能力注册：为纯 JavaScript 页面上真实浏览器渲染、用 CSS/XPath 取出结构化数据而不是 Markdown、选择器自愈、可复用的登录态会话、XHR 抓取、页面截图、受部署门禁的浏览器动作，以及在官方作业后端上跑的限定域爬虫（con…

description.en: Automatic recovery when a turn ends badly: resume after a transient failure, continue after output truncation, re-run after an unfinished todo list, plus a…

description.en: Semantic workspace search: three model tools (`zg_search`, `zg_index`, `zg_status`) drive the `zg` CLI for hybrid BM25 + vector + RRF retrieval, with a…

description.en: Connect a DSH Agent to Minecraft Java servers with Mineflayer, a live game view alongside native reasoning and tools, configurable personas, server-scoped…
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Mineflayer 进入 Minecraft Java 服务器，在实时游戏画面旁查看原生推理与工具，配置人格、按服务器隔离的笔记及可选本地生存知识检索；复用宿主模型，安装本身不连接游戏或启动推理。

description.en: 11 shareable workflow skills (handoff, triage, to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder, teach, wait-what, dsh-mode-routing, ask-matt, overnight-execution,…

description.zh: DSH 插件，注册 13 个原生 codegraph_* 工具包装 codegraph CLI，让代理初始化、维护并查询预索引的代码知识图谱（符号查询、区域探索、节点轨迹、callers/callees、影响分析、受影响测试），无需 grep 文件。

description.en: Composer prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: a button beside the model selector rewrites the draft through one auxiliary LLM call and writes the result…

description.en: Right-click any file reference in the chat to open it, open it with an associated application, reveal it in the file manager, copy its path or contents, and…

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills in DeepSeek Harness, and control which tools enter the next prompt.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器与 Skill，并控制下一轮 prompt 带入哪些工具。

description.en: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal,…
description.zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

description.en: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and…
description.zh: DSH 插件信任流水线：确定性静态扫描判定、可选运行时守卫与蜜罐诱饵、agent 审查协议技能与浏览器盾牌状态灯，只报警不执法。

description.en: Integrates coding agent CLIs, persistent terminals and remote workspaces into the native DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 将十几种编程助手 CLI、持久终端与远程工作区接入 DSH 原生界面。

description.en: Local development service console for DSH: lists every listening service on the machine and lets users inspect, safely stop, or restart services that were…

description.en: Standalone workspace file-tree panel for the DSH web UI: a session-header icon opens an animated popup of the current workspace tree; click or drag a file to…
description.zh: 独立单功能的工作区文件树面板：会话头部图标打开当前工作区目录树的动画弹窗；点击或拖拽文件即可把引用插入输入框；自带搜索、行内预览、实时设置与中英双语；零配置，一条命令即装即用。

description.en: Improve the current chat draft before sending with a confirm-before-apply comparison.
description.zh: 在发送前优化当前聊天输入，采用前先对比原文与优化结果。

description.en: Zen Mode view tab and foreground time tracker for DeepSeek Harness: while the agent works, a calm conversation view shows running/done status, your latest user…
description.zh: 禅模式视图 + 前台盯屏时间统计插件：智能体后台运行时提供极简 Zen 标签页（进行中/结束状态文案、用户消息、动态提示、Markdown 渲染最终回复、单行轮次统计），统计前台盯屏时长并给出每日/每周禅值，支持一键隐藏中间过程（工具调用/推理行）、任务开始完成时自动进出禅、Alt+Z 快捷键与 Zen…

description.en: Run Blender headless from DeepSeek Harness: execute bpy scripts, render scenes and export glTF assets, with modeling cookbook, 5.x pitfall list and…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里以 headless 方式跑 Blender：执行 bpy 脚本、渲染场景、导出 glTF 资产，并附带建模技法库、5.x 踩坑清单与资产管线手册（技能包），让 agent 在交付前自检几何。

description.en: Production pack for ComfyUI inside DeepSeek Harness: submit API-format workflows to a local or remote server, batch-generate and fetch outputs, and diagnose…
description.zh: ComfyUI 在 DeepSeek Harness 里的生产包：向本地或远程服务提交 API 格式工作流、批量出图并取回产物，附实测参数区间与崩图排查决策树（黑图、主体重复、彩边、显存不足）。

description.en: Three-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness — a small always-on core block plus on-demand topic files (profile, preferences, decisions, lessons), with…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的三层记忆：常驻小索引加按需读取的主题文件（画像、偏好、决策、教训），写入带来源标注、冲突取代留痕，让偏好与项目约束跨会话不漂移。本地优先：无向量库、无服务端、零出站。

description.en: Rotates images and videos from a media folder as the DSH UI background, with panel controls for the rotation interval and UI opacity.
description.zh: 把媒体目录中的图片与视频自动轮换为 DSH 界面背景，面板可调轮播间隔与界面透明度。

description.en: DSH environment diagnosis, graded repair with one-click rollback, and a runtime self-healing service.
description.zh: DSH 环境诊断、分级修复与一键回滚，附带运行时自愈服务。

description.en: One-click upgrade to Deepseek Harness, with version number displayed in the sidebar.
description.zh: 一键升级Deepseek Harness, 支持侧边栏显示版本号.

description.en: Per-conversation backup for DSH: incremental session mirroring, fuzzy restore (preview then confirm), and rule-based cleanup with a 7-day recycle bin.

description.en: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and…

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 启动成功后运行用户自定义命令的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。

description.en: Semantic-layer analytics tool that uses curated table, column and metric metadata with Qdrant and Elasticsearch recall to generate, validate and execute MySQL…

description.en: Heartbeat loop for DeepSeek Harness: every 20 minutes (by default) the agent wakes on its own to keep a local profile of your interests and preferences, search…
description.zh: 心跳循环：默认每 20 分钟自己醒一次——维护一份关于你兴趣与偏好的本地画像，按你设的兴趣范围上网搜新东西并存下来。攒到值得分享的内容，就向你绑定的会话送一份简短的素材包。能不能开口由代码里的规则决定（静默时段、忙时窗口、每日上限、冷却），说不说由那个会话里的 agent 自己判断。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Keenable web search and page fetch for the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, working with any model and no API key.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 工具提供 Keenable 网页搜索与网页读取，适用于任意模型，无需 API Key。

description.en: Sidebar billing dashboard: real usage aggregated from session logs (per-model and per-day calls/tokens/cache), cost estimated in CNY from a current…

description.en: Network explorer for kids: my identity, DNS lookup, a traceroute trip, speed test and who is home on the LAN.

description.en: Processes as little workers: how many, the busiest, the family tree and badges.
description.zh: 进程小工人：数量、谁最卖力、家族树、工牌。

description.en: Computer safety shown as castle guards: firewall, disk encryption, lock screen, remote ports and login history.
description.zh: 电脑安全小城堡守卫：防火墙、磁盘加密、锁屏、远程端口、登录记录。

description.en: Storage explorer: disk boxes, the home folder and the heaviest items.
description.zh: 存储小仓库：磁盘分区、主目录、最占空间的东西。

description.en: System monitor for kids: a single card summary of CPU, memory and disk.
description.zh: 系统小监控：一张卡片看 CPU、内存、磁盘概况。

description.en: Session cost estimate in a status bar at the bottom of the conversation (per-model token pricing, CNY) plus the live DeepSeek account balance via the official…

description.en: GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen with a selectable calendar-year view, green/blue color schemes, and today / this-month /…
description.zh: 新建会话页的 GitHub 风格每日 Token 用量热力图：可选日历年度视图、绿/蓝配色与显示开关，并附今日/本月/累计总量。

description.en: DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.

description.en: Live session-title provider for dsh that regenerates the title after every user message, summarizing the most recent messages within a byte budget.
description.zh: DSH 会话标题实时生成器：每条用户消息后重新生成标题，在字节预算内概括最近几条消息。

description.en: Self-maintained DSH web task board with a human acceptance gate, card kinds and editable notes on executed cards.

description.en: Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer's model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.

description.zh: DSH 双引擎截图：思灵桌面壳内，全局快捷键/托盘打开全屏框选浮层（多显示器、逐屏像素级抓帧），选区定格后工具条就地画红框，一次确认送进输入框；纯 DSH（浏览器）下由输入框相机按钮经 getDisplayMedia 捕获屏幕，复用同一套单阶段框选+标注遮罩。均走官方附件通道。

description.en: Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 画卷式消息导航栏：会话面板右侧一条竖排导轨，每条用户消息一个指示点，scroll-spy 跟随阅读位置，hover 展开画卷查看完整消息预览，点击跳转任意历史消息；与 better-sidebar 面板动画同步避让。

description.en: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.
description.zh: 注入一条固定 system-prompt 段落，让 Agent 无论用户使用什么语言都始终用中文思考和回复。

description.en: Draft polish for the DSH composer: one-click AI polish of the input draft (sparkles button next to send), with optional conversation context and a configurable…
description.zh: DSH 输入框草稿润色：发送键左侧一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，可携带会话上下文，模型渠道可配置。

description.en: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in a session tab: the AI hosts the game and plays every other seat, each knowing only its own role book, while the player's seat…
description.zh: 一个人的剧本杀：AI 当主持人，AI 填满其余的椅子（各自只知道自己的角色本），留一个位子给你 —— 带阶段条、按座位归集的时间线与搜证页，而真相到复盘才解封。

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate,…
description.zh: 跨会话明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

description.en: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话节点外观插件：按节点类别/工具名可配置着色（左侧色条 + 淡色底），附带"显示思考过程"开关；纯前端渲染增强，改动即时生效并持久化到 DSH 用户设置文件。

description.en: Plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: installed-plugin metadata, a community market with stars and versions, one-click install and update, and a What's New…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：已安装插件信息、带星标与版本号的社区市场、一键安装与更新，以及启动时的更新日志弹窗。

description.en: Skill and MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and toggle user/project skills, add/edit/remove MCP servers hot without restart, with live…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 管理中心：浏览并启停用户/项目技能，热增删改 MCP 服务器（免重启），侧边栏实时展示各服务器状态。

description.en: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: instance info, repository listing, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs…
description.zh: 面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：实例信息、仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索和读取、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。工具元数据支持英文、繁体中文、简体中文与日文。

description.en: Multi-agent meeting negotiation over the LAN: each person runs their own assistant, and assistants find each other via mDNS and negotiate meetings, weekend…
description.zh: 局域网多智能体会议协商：每人一个助理，助理通过 mDNS 互相发现，用 A2A 报文协商排会、周末团建和奶茶投票。对外只给忙闲不说原因，占用本人保护的时段前先问本人。DSH 侧栏自带手机样式页面和 13 人示例公司。无鉴权，仅限可信局域网。

description.en: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable…
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供直接操控本机完整 DSH 实例的能力：目标 DSH 无需安装任何插件或额外组件，零侵入，环境隔离便于用户直接让agent为另一环境进行修改配置到自主测试,也能让不同模型、不同人格的 Agent 互相聊天、角色扮演或层层套娃，探索趣味玩法，可通过对话由 Agent…

description.en: Decentralized, offline-first graph memory and task graph for DSH, with signed facts, multi-device sync, and the shared Mebular Console embedded in a sidebar…
description.zh: 去中心化、离线优先的 DSH 图式记忆与任务图：签名事实、多设备同步，并在侧边栏复用 Mebular 共享控制台。需本机已运行 Mebular 守护进程（Mebular 桌面 App，或 @mebular/core 的 mebular serve）；本插件只把它的记忆工具与控制台面板接入 DSH。

description.en: Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.
description.zh: 基于 Tavily 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量与时间窗口的设置卡片。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless…
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and…
description.zh: 将 Memory Lake 作为 dsh 的持久记忆层：基于 memorylake CLI 的 memory_search、memory_remember、memory_forget 三个工具，会话状态行，以及引导安装/诊断 skills，与 Claude Code、Codex 插件共享同一…

description.en: Port of ponytail: an always-on lazy-senior-developer coding persona with intensity levels, persistence of the default level, and review, audit, debt, gain and…
description.zh: ponytail 移植：常驻的「懒惰资深开发者」编码人设，带强度档位与 review、audit、debt、gain、help 技能，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面增强：一键检查更新、DeepSeek 余额与 API Key、导入其他 AI 工具。

description.en: Adds a summonable domain-expert roster that runs as subagents while the parent session keeps the task and final answer.
description.zh: 增加可召唤的领域专家名单，专家以子代理运行，主会话保留任务和最终答复。

description.en: Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.
description.zh: 在设置里增加已归档会话页，可按工作区搜索、恢复和删除已归档会话。

description.en: Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.
description.zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。

description.en: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without…
description.zh: 提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。

description.en: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a…
description.zh: 提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。

description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question…
description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。

description.en: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端重构 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航。

description.en: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.
description.zh: 把微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书、Lark、QQ、Telegram 接到本机 DeepSeek Harness，每个 IM 聊天对应一条独立工作区频道。

description.en: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and…
description.zh: 提供 /pua，在 Agent 失败后促使其换方法，并在宣称完成前核验收据；含 15 种公司风格、角色模式、全局与会话设置，以及可选验收循环（直到验收命令通过、达到迭代上限或用户取消）。

description.en: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。

description.en: Manages local DeepSeek Harness skills in Settings and shows shared Agent skills as read-only.
description.zh: 在设置里管理本地 DSH 技能，并只读查看公共 Agent 技能。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications and custom HTTP pushes when tasks finish or need your attention.
description.zh: 在任务结束或需要处理时发送桌面通知和自定义 HTTP 推送。

description.en: Adds a Continue button to resume tasks interrupted by a process exit or restart.
description.zh: 为进程退出或重启导致中断的任务提供继续按钮。

description.en: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic,…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

description.en: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export…
description.zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

description.en: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a…
description.zh: AI 原生多模态画布，支持图片、视频、音频、3D 模型、PDF、文档与代码等文件展示与预览；通过节点连线组织素材，与 Agent 共享上下文、协作编辑，内容持久保存在本机。

description.en: Desktop-grade companion: browser native notifications for user questions and approval interactions, screen capture model tool, multi-agent tiling grid view,…
description.zh: 桌面级增强套件：原生提问/审批交互通知、屏幕截图工具、多智能体平铺网格视图与轻量级 Tauri 桌面外壳。

description.en: The memory that dreams — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: recalls you and your projects across sessions, consolidates memories while idle…
description.zh: 会做梦的记忆 — DeepSeek Harness 跨会话记忆插件：跨会话记住你与项目，空闲时自动巩固记忆（autoDream），冲突记忆先冻结待你裁决，全程可回放审计。记忆落在本机：SQLite 存储配可人工编辑的 Markdown 镜像；附带四路召回（关键词、向量、BM25、实体图谱）与交互式记忆库面板，另有…

description.en: Dual-host coordination for DeepSeek Harness: hand a task off in local chat, run bounded jobs in a cloud worker, then review results and approve follow-up steps…
description.zh: DSH 双端协作：在本地对话中自然语言交办，云端独立 worker 执行有界任务，在工作台查看成果并逐步审批后续动作。含六页保护性配置导览、按任务选模型、审批账本与受控交付。

description.en: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per…
description.zh: Tavily 搜索、提取、站点地图与爬取工具：多 Key 轮换，HTTP 401/429/432/433 故障转移，并提供按账号限制并发请求的负载均衡模式；插件配置页含密钥与用量卡片。内置 web_search 永不替换。

description.en: Recoverable file and Git operations for coding agents, with shared recovery and redaction tools, a DSH shell adapter and audit records; optional native…
description.zh: 为编码 Agent 提供可恢复的文件和 Git 操作、共享恢复与脱敏工具及 DSH Shell 适配器；保留审计记录，可选原生文本读取保护默认关闭。

description.en: Media and vision workspace for DeepSeek Harness: image, video and speech generation, image Q&A and element locating, long-image OCR, pixel diff,…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的媒体与视觉工作台：文生图、图/文生视频、语音合成与转写、图像问答与元素定位、长图 OCR、像素比对、HTML 截图验证、视频摘要；支持 DashScope 与 OpenAI 兼容供应商，含模型池与工作台客户端。

description.en: Let DeepSeek Harness see and operate any program on Windows. The model looks at the real screen and drives the mouse, keyboard and windows itself. It is fast:…
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 看见并操作 Windows 上的任何程序。模型直接看真实屏幕，自己驱动鼠标、键盘和窗口。特点是快：好几步动作在一次往返里跑完，输入前还能先把目标窗口聚焦，点击就落在正确的窗口上。你在桌面上能做的事它都能做，包括但不限于画 CAD、电路图仿真、发消息。

description.en: Browse, search and install skills from the public SkillHub catalogue, then enable, disable, update or remove them without leaving Harness. Category chips carry…
description.zh: 浏览、搜索并安装公开的 SkillHub 技能库,启用、停用、更新或卸载都不必离开 Harness。分类按钮带该分类的上游总数;详情抽屉提供文件树、版本历史、权限、第三方安全扫描结论与上游指标等页签。装好的技能会作为一个普通本地技能写入 harness 的技能根目录,而「停用」是把它的目录移出该根目录,不是打标记。

description.en: File-defined command hooks across the session, prompt, tool, permission, Stop and PostCompact seams, with an approval-only GUI: no unapproved command runs, and…
description.zh: 文件声明的命令钩子，覆盖会话、提问、工具、审批、Stop 与压缩后等事件，配套只读审批界面：未经批准的命令不执行，批准绑定精确定义、实际执行目录与 watchFiles 固定内容。命令以 DSH 系统用户身份运行且无独立沙箱，因此信任记录是显式的。

description.en: MCP server console under Plugins: manage the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client at runtime — add/edit/delete servers, enable/disable/reconnect, per-tool…
description.zh: 插件页 MCP 服务器控制台：运行时管理官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client——新增/编辑/删除服务器、启停/重连、工具级开关、SSE 实时状态与工具列表、mcpServers JSON 导入、自动迁移 profile YAML 里的 MCP 条目；卸载后留下原生 fallback…

description.en: Safe detached DSH restart: /restart and /dsh-restart slash commands with native candidate styling plus a dsh_restart agent tool; a detached worker restarts DSH…
description.zh: 安全的分离式 DSH 重启：/restart 与 /dsh-restart 斜杠命令（原生候选样式）加 dsh_restart Agent 工具；分离的 worker 在 3 秒后重启 DSH 且会话不冻结，Windows/macOS 走基于官方 appExit 服务的原生 Node helper。

description.en: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.
description.zh: 离线诊断工具：环境/Profile/会话共 19 项检查，带设置「诊断」面板与只读 JSON API。

description.en: Adds two buttons to the sidebar footer: one reloads the interface and client plugins only, the other restarts the desktop app together with its Host. A restart…
description.zh: 在侧栏底部添加两个按钮：一个只重新加载界面与客户端插件，另一个连同 Host 重启整个桌面应用；插件安装期间拒绝重启。重启仅支持 Windows，其他平台返回 409；刷新全平台可用。

description.en: Lists the skills in the shared skills directory with their source and version, installs and updates them from a GitHub repo, removes them to a recycle bin kept…
description.zh: 汇总共享技能目录里的技能并标注来源与版本，可从 GitHub 仓库安装与更新，删除时先进保留 7 天的回收站，并控制每个技能对各 Agent 的可见性与模型可调用性。

description.en: A secret store for DSH Desktop that keeps API keys in one place and injects them into the assistant's shell as $DSH_* variables.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供密钥库，集中保管 API 密钥并以 $DSH_* 变量注入助手的 shell 中。

description.en: A row of model preset buttons above the composer: left-click switches the session to that preset's provider, model and reasoning effort, right-click opens an…
description.zh: 输入框上方的一排模型预设按钮：左键点击把当前会话切换到该预设的提供方、模型与思考强度，右键点击打开该预设的编辑弹窗，每个预设还可以自定义备注名称而不必使用模型名。编辑弹窗读取当前会话真实的模型目录，预设保存在本地。

description.en: Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines,…
description.zh: 飞书/Lark 深度通道：原生思考过程消息、审批卡片、goal/todo 实时卡片、workflow 展开行、会话全文检索、后台任务与子代理结算通知。其设计以飞书应用自身的可见性范围为访问边界——凡是应用允许触达的人都能驱动 agent 并回答它的审批请求，除非填写可选的发送者/群组/审批人白名单收窄。

description.en: Fine-grained permission gateway: per-category tool-call review (outside-workspace directories, commands, file read/write, subagents, repeated actions) with…
description.zh: 细粒度权限网关：按分类（工作区外目录/命令/读写文件/子代理/重复操作）逐项审查工具调用，全局/项目双级白黑名单、快捷工具默认值、自定义规则，中英文审批弹窗（内联 diff 详情、自定义拒绝意见）与底层沙箱升级流程。

description.en: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent plugin.
description.zh: 技能驱动的 harness/loop 工程化工作流插件。

description.en: Patent-writing gatekeeper for dsh - screens the idea against Chinese prior art first, then runs five-party alignment interviews, eight-chapter disclosure…
description.zh: dsh 专利撰写把关人：动笔前先检索中国专利给出三档结论，再走五方对齐访谈、八章交底书、附图与仿真实验、七维审查与 docx/PDF 导出全流程。技能开箱即用；检索、导出与实验工具来自内置的 Python MCP 服务，默认关闭——在 ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml 里开一行即启用，uvx…

description.en: Dynamically trusts every Host header that actually arrives and flips the default web binding to 0.0.0.0: wildcard or unenumerable entry domains work without…
description.zh: 动态信任所有实际到达的 Host 并把 web 默认绑定翻转为 0.0.0.0：泛域名等无法枚举的入口免改启动命令，认证层不动，超出容量的 Host 按 LRU 淘汰。

description.en: Conversation enhancements: a history-input overlay (Alt+Up with workspace/session/global/prompt scopes), recall of unapplied interjected messages, conversation…

description.en: Session usage statistics panel: token and request stats at day/hour/minute granularity, an activity heatmap, bottom-bar session info takeover with per-turn…
description.zh: 会话用量统计面板：天/小时/分钟三粒度 token 与请求统计、活跃热力图、会话底栏信息接管与回合费用芯片、多条件分时段定价费用估算；复刻自 HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel 并扩展。

description.en: Multi-platform LLM balance and quota panel: configure DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, MiniMax, NewApi or custom endpoints, poll on a schedule, draw…

description.en: Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.

description.zh: 对话内生成式 UI：模型把交互式 HTML 卡片直接画进会话流，带流式预览与沙箱渲染。

description.en: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.
description.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。

description.en: Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace's single one,…

description.en: Turns a DSH deployment into one node of a decentralized agent network — signed agent cards, peer and zone discovery, direct message-routing model tools, and…

description.en: Multi-agent roundtable discussion: each member runs as a subagent on its own model and speaks in turn, a host summarizes each round, and termination writes…

description.en: Cross-workspace worker fleets: one orchestrating session spawns named worker sessions in other project workspaces, queues or steers tasks into them, watches…
description.zh: 跨工作区的多智能体工舰队：一个编排会话在其他项目工作区中创建具名的 worker 会话，向其排队或插队下发任务，以后台任务的方式监视其进度，并收集其报告。worker 完成后主动把消息投递到编排会话，无需轮询，空闲的编排器同样能及时反应。当编排器正在执行任务时，升级提问与失败通知以 steer 方式送达，空闲时以…

description.en: Catppuccin themes plus a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web GUI: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the native theme runtime,…

description.zh: 把 NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek 节点接入 DSH：五个只读工具，覆盖版本与上游出处、数据目录恢复状态与账本审计、一致性向量、精确十进制换算，以及节点可达性探测。刻意不暴露启动/停止守护进程、存款、发总线消息这类在本项目里受审计的特权操作。

description.en: Run one instruction on every online Windows and macOS machine, across networks and regions: a dependency-free relay talks to each machine over outbound…
description.zh: 一条指令同时下发给所有在线的 Windows 与 macOS 机器，可跨网络跨区域：零依赖中继只通过出站连接与各机通信（Tailscale 内网、公网 VPS + TLS、或隧道），各机在各自的项目副本上执行，结果连同 commit、工作区指纹与命令哈希一并回传，因此"环境不一致"会被判为…

description.en: A Claude Code-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web UI: stepless drag, snap-on-release, a WebGL fire trail, and real, working thinking-effort control…
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的推理等级滑块：无极拖动、松手吸附、WebGL 火焰跟随，任何自定义第三方模型/提供商都能获得真实生效的思考强度调节。

description.en: A plugin manager tab in Settings → Plugins: Chinese names and plain-language descriptions for every installed plugin, one-click enable/disable, in-UI notes…
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的插件管理页：已装插件中文名与白话描述、一键启停、界面内改备注，支持搜索与筛选。

description.en: Shows the API balance of the provider behind the current model as a dsh Web sidebar card, with per-package progress bars, currency/credit-aware units, a…
description.zh: 在当前会话所用模型的厂商 API 余额，以 dsh Web 侧边栏卡片常驻展示，含每套餐进度条、货币/积分单位区分、设置页，以及订阅与积分额度监测。

description.en: Open dsh web from your phone or another computer through a UUMit account, without running your own server or installing another program: a built-in tunnel…
description.zh: 用 UUMit 账号在手机或其他电脑上打开这台电脑的 dsh web，不用自建服务器、不装其他程序：插件内置通道客户端连接 UUMit 托管的通道，侧栏里的面板负责配对和选择谁能用（仅自己、通过邀请链接或手机号授权的人、所有人），可随时撤销。需 dsh web 且 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: China A-share financial data MCP server for the harness: 11 fin_data__* tools (quotes/K-lines/financials/calendar/special-data/announcements/EDB/reconcile/funds…
description.zh: 中国 A 股金融数据 MCP server：11 个 fin_data__* 工具（行情/K线/财务/日历/特色数据/公告/EDB/对账/基金/指数），同花顺免费官方 REST 主干 + AKShare 兜底 + Wind 独家域，降级全程可观测；上下文压缩（实测结果侧 -72.2%）；离线 10 年数据湖；BYOK…

description.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
description.zh: Hindsight：会学习的 Agent 长期记忆系统，自动召回/保存、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆银行。

description.en: Brings the models available in the logged-in WorkBuddy desktop app into the model picker, reusing the app login and credits; the domestic and international…
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里可用的模型接进模型选择器，复用 App 的登录与积分；国内版与国际版各成一组。corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect（仓库已删除）的续作；注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它…

description.en: Floating pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows OpenCode Go usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as three rings, optionally alongside the DeepSeek…
description.zh: DSH 悬浮窗插件：三环显示 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月用量，可选同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额；悬停浮层列出各窗口与重置倒计时，极简模式把三环嵌套显示；设置页可调刷新间隔、进度口径、显示项与浮窗位置。

description.en: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.
description.zh: 一个 Obsidian 风格的知识库：摄取资料，让 LLM 构建并维护互联 wiki，并基于它提问。

description.en: A pinned-sessions group in the sidebar, above the workspace list: every pinned session across all workspaces in one collapsible, searchable list, with…
description.zh: 侧栏「工作区」上方的一个置顶分组：跨工作区汇总所有置顶会话，可折叠、可就地搜索，点行打开、悬停出现取消置顶按钮。

description.en: Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek 官方 Search/Fetch 接口做网页搜索、单页抓取与一键调研；需要一个 DeepSeek API key。

description.en: Plugin center for VibeDev: describes the official VibeDev plugins and installs them in one click through the plugin manager (inspect, install disabled, then…
description.zh: VibeDev 插件中心：介绍 VibeDev 官方插件，并通过官方插件管理器一键安装（先检查、先不启用地安装、再启用，并带上前置依赖）。另提供套装安装、旧包名迁移，以及一键安装插件市场 dshmarket。

description.en: Self-evolving project-level Agent for DeepSeek Harness: 16 SDD workflow skills (clarification, PRD, issue, coding, locating, acceptance, review) plus project…
description.zh: 会进化的项目级 Agent：以 SDD 规格驱动掌舵全流程，内置 16 个技能覆盖澄清、PRD、issue、编码、定位、验收、审查；会记忆、会沉淀，越用越懂你的项目。

description.en: Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) so tool output is compressed before it reaches the model, by asking the installed rtk to rewrite…
description.zh: 把符合条件的 bash 命令交给 rtk（Rust Token Killer）执行，让工具输出在进入模型之前就被压缩：插件调用本机 rtk 重写命令并采纳其结果；rtk 未安装时，执行器行为与原生完全一致。

description.en: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.
description.zh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

description.en: Conversation node navigation bar for quick jumps between user messages.
description.zh: 对话节点导航条，右缘节点串快速跳转 user 消息。

description.en: Ecosystem infrastructure: a thin browser console for managing official repository plugins (zero patches) plus a make-dsh-plugin skill for guided plugin…
description.zh: 插件生态基建：浏览器面板管理官方 repository 插件（0 patch）+ make-dsh-plugin 插件开发引导技能。

description.en: Adds a Managed Agents settings tab and MCP tools to dispatch long-running agent tasks to Ark cloud Managed Agents.
description.zh: 新增 Managed Agents 设置页，并通过 MCP 工具向方舟云端 Managed Agents 派发长任务、取回轨迹与产物。

description.en: Registers Ark Agent Plan, Coding Plan and postpaid model routes in the native DSH model picker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生模型选择器中注册方舟 Agent Plan、Coding Plan 与后付费模型路由。

description.en: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous…
description.zh: dsh 的对话式语音前端 Agent：通过 ByteDance Duplex 自然对话，把语音请求委派给后台任务，并用语音回报异步结果。

description.en: Context trimmer: lists the current session's context entries with role, preview and ≈token estimate (cl100k), highlights over-threshold items, and removes…
description.zh: 上下文剃刀：把当前会话上下文逐条列出（角色/预览/≈token 估算），超阈值标红，勾选后不经 LLM 精确裁剪，删了什么一目了然。

description.en: White noise player: lays a layer of background sound (rain, streams, campfire, café) while AI codes, for flow and focus. Supports multiple playback modes…
description.zh: 白噪音播放器：AI 编程时铺一层背景音（雨声、溪流、篝火、咖啡馆……），帮助进入心流状态、集中精力、高效思考。支持顺序/随机/单曲循环/间歇等多种播放模式。支持 AI 自动从 Wikimedia Commons 下载 CC0/PD/CC BY 背景音乐到对应场景文件夹。

description.en: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to…
description.zh: 自动续跑：agent 会话中断后自动续上，规则表按失败类型（限流/额度/鉴权/上下文超限/崩溃孤儿）路由——自动退避重试、换模型继续、压缩上下文后继续或止损通知，规则可视化编辑，全程活动日志。

description.en: Usage dashboard: offline-scans session logs to chart daily/weekly/monthly tokens, estimated costs, model/tool/skill/command leaderboards, output speed, working…
description.zh: 使用量仪表盘：离线扫描会话日志，统计每日/每周/每月 token、估算费用、模型/工具/技能/命令榜、输出速度、工作时段与质量指标；gridstack+ECharts 卡片可拖拽编排，支持自定义公式与 AI 编排（提示词往返导入）。

description.en: Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom…
description.zh: 会话收藏夹：把任意会话收藏进浏览器收藏夹式的管理面板——左侧会话行一键收藏/星标，主面板支持文件夹分门别类、备注、自定义显示名、一键继续会话、Fork 新会话、会话基本统计，外加一张清晰展示会话派生关系的 fork 关系图。

description.en: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks,…
description.zh: FDE 工具箱全家桶：安装一个插件带上一批常用 dsh 插件（代码仓库 / 挂载盘 / 知识库 / 定时任务 / 自动续跑 / 界面微调 / 自动复盘 / 文件管理 / 智能标题 / 任务看板 / 插件市场 / 上下文 / IM 接入 / 侧栏增强），面板看状态、一键补装。

description.en: Session workspace file manager: adds a "Files" tab to the conversation area to browse the current session workspace directory tree and manage it in place…
description.zh: 会话工作区文件管理：在对话区加「文件」tab，浏览当前会话工作区的目录树并就地管理（上传/下载/新建文件夹/改名/删除/搜索），文件可 @ 进对话框给 agent 处理。

description.en: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes — welcome show, per-turn salutes, tool sparks, milestone…
description.zh: 烟花庆祝引擎：agent 编程时漂浮在对话窗口上空放烟花——开场迎宾、回合礼花、工具星花、里程碑大礼、收工终场、失败哑炮，每类事件一张烟花属性卡组，组内多变种随机抽取，token 用量决定烟花的大小、高度与绚烂程度。

description.en: Execution flow chart: renders the current session's execution as a vertical node flow (turns, user, assistant, tools, approvals, retries, compaction), appended…
description.zh: 执行流程图：把当前会话的执行过程画成一条纵向节点流（回合/用户/助手/工具/审批/重试/压缩），SSE 实时追加——会话执行到哪，图就画到哪，自动跟随滚动。

description.en: Gaokao countdown blackboard: counts down the days to the gaokao on a desktop blackboard widget that collapses into a slim bar on double-click, and quizzes…
description.zh: 梦回高三：桌面小黑板高考倒计时（双击收成竖条），AI 干活时随机抽背知识点卡；Markdown 开放知识卡框架——按学科/分类放 md 即自动加载，支持关联跳转/收藏/重点学科/导入自己的知识库。

description.en: Git server: embeds ts-gogs (a TypeScript reimplementation of Gogs) and serves a full Git service on its own port — HTTP clone/push, web UI, issues/PRs/wiki —…
description.zh: Git 服务器：内嵌 ts-gogs（Gogs 的 TypeScript 平替），独立端口跑完整 Git 服务（HTTP clone/push、网页端、issue/PR/wiki），可复用 user-management 的用户名密码，设置页一键启停。

description.en: Team knowledge base for offline knowledge sharing (FDE box scenario): browse, full-text search and refinement entry points; raw material is queued…
description.zh: 团队知识库：离线知识共享（FDE 盒子场景），浏览/全文检索/加工入口；raw 入料自动入队、bot 会话串行蒸馏成文（Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式：raw 不可变 / 两步加工 / log 流水 / 月度 lint）。

description.en: Kite-flying engine: while the agent codes, an animated kite drifts and sways in the wind on screen, tethered to the bottom edge of the window — the busier the…
description.zh: 放风筝引擎：agent 编程时屏幕上放一只动画风筝——token 越多事件越密风筝飞得越高，随风漂移摆动，一根线牵在窗口底边；潍坊系框架卡组（沙燕/金鱼/蝴蝶/八卦/龙头等，硬翅软翅板式立体），形状×图案×配色全是可替换数据配置，支持把用户上传的图片糊上风筝面，贴图随风筝侧正斜的姿态实时仿射变换。

description.en: Matrix digital rain: drapes the chat window in the classic green character rain — cascading columns with incandescent white heads and green tails, streaming…
description.zh: 黑客帝国数字雨：对话窗口铺上经典的绿色字符雨背景——雨柱倾泻而下、白炽雨头绿身拖尾，agent 正在生成的 token 原文实时掺进雨里；透明度/速度/密度/字号/配色全部可调，雨势跟随 agent 活跃度起伏。

description.en: Process management: brings ntd-style processes (multi-stage, multi-step agent workflow templates) into the dsh web UI — browse, edit, validate, import/export…
description.zh: 工艺管理：把 ntd 的「工艺」（多阶段·多环节 agent 工作流模板）接进 dsh web——浏览/编辑/校验/导入导出/AI 生成工艺，内置库只读、我的库可写，文件改动实时同步；agent 可通过 process_* 工具读工艺库、按工艺分阶段推进。

description.en: Customizes the native settings window: preset or custom window sizes, fullscreen, background transparency, and theme, solid-color, or image backgrounds, with a…
description.zh: 设置界面自定义：调整原生设置窗口大小（全屏/预置大尺寸/自定义宽高）、背景透明度与背景（主题/自定义颜色/图片），悬浮球即开即调，存本机浏览器。

description.en: Sidebar tidy: when plugins pile up, the rows under 'New session' get crowded with panel and plugin entries. This plugin folds them all — global panel rows,…
description.zh: 侧栏收纳：把「新会话」下方被各插件塞满的入口行——全局面板行、插件入口行（自家/第三方一律识别）、底部入口——统统收进一个菜单按钮，点开二级菜单原样触发各入口；想常驻的加名称白名单即可，侧栏折叠成窄轨时按钮自动变纯图标。

description.en: Smart session titles for DSH: after each conversation turn an independent auxiliary LLM call summarizes the full user+assistant transcript into a title that…
description.zh: 会话智能标题：每轮对话结束后用一次独立的辅助 LLM 调用对「用户消息+助手回答」的完整转写做总结，标题跟随会话真实主题而不是复述第一句话；首条消息即时出题、内置标题失败在后续轮次自动重试、用户手动改名绝不被覆盖、自动跳过子代理与 fork 会话。

description.en: Multi-machine sync: keeps multiple dsh replicas consistent through one private GitCode repository — skills, sessions, settings and plugin manifests each with…
description.zh: 多机同步：让多台机器上的 dsh 通过一个私有 GitCode 仓库保持一致——技能、会话、设置、插件清单四类内容各有独立开关；变更走分支 → PR → 合并，推送前自动回填远端新增防误删，支持 AI 智能对齐（语义合并双方改动）与一键解决冲突；强制私有仓库，pull 不覆盖本地改动。

description.en: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming,…
description.zh: 定时任务：用 cron 表达式定时执行提示词，到点自动开一个新 agent 会话替你干活，支持绑定工作区、手动立即执行与会话自动命名。

description.en: Think tank: a built-in library of 161 classic mental models (decision/strategy/cognition/psychology/communication/learning/system/innovation/execution) — enter…
description.zh: 智囊团：内置 161 个经典思维模型库（决策/战略/认知/心理/沟通/学习/系统/创新/执行九大分类），输入一个问题即可用选中的多个模型并行 AI 分析，产出含共识/分歧/盲区/行动清单的综合报告页；支持自动分析与提示词往返导入两种模式。

description.en: WebDAV server: turns a shared directory into a WebDAV service that Windows, macOS and Linux can mount as a local disk, with token authentication, optional…
description.zh: WebDAV 服务器：把一个共享目录变成 Windows/macOS/Linux 都能挂载成本地磁盘的 WebDAV 服务，令牌认证、可选只读、目录/端口/令牌全可配，设置页自带三平台挂载指南。

description.en: Expert manager: manage ntd-format experts and expert teams (plugin.json + Agent MD + skill sets), browse and install from a built-in market of 50+ experts, and…
description.zh: 专家管理：管理 ntd 格式的专家与专家团队（plugin.json + Agent MD + 技能集），内置 50+ 专家市场，`/expert-名称` 以专家身份执行任务，不占模型目录 token。

description.en: Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to…
description.zh: 自动复盘：对话收尾后自动把有价值的经验蒸馏成可复用的技能（skill）存入技能库，支持信号加速触发、手动立即复盘、审批模式与技能库治理（归档/恢复，永不直接删除）。

description.en: Skill marketplace and manager: manage skills from all local coding agents (10+ executors, incl. Claude Code and Codex) in one page and import them into the DSH…
description.zh: 技能市场：一个页面管理本机所有 coding agent 的技能，一键收编进 DSH 用户库；内置 6600+ 技能市场，支持注入开销（≈token）统计与模型可见性治理。

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web UI: unauthenticated visitors get a login/register page and the first registrant becomes admin; includes user and role management…
description.zh: 用户管理：给 dsh web 加登录门禁，未登录访问弹登录/注册页，首个注册者自动成为管理员；管理员可管理用户/角色，带登录与访问审计。

description.en: Unified model routing for DeepSeek Harness: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking,…
description.zh: 统一模型路由：一个逻辑 ModelID 汇聚多家供应商，首 token 前失败自动切换并冷却、健康度择优、按 purpose 三档分级（tier1/2/3）、每候选思考级别，设置面板自动保存即时生效。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：DietrichGebert/ponytail 懒人 senior 模式与七阶梯子完美移植，6 个技能描述双语自由切换，各个技能自由开关，零 tool 注册，全场景零缓存破坏。

description.en: Claude Code-style prompt history, double-Esc picker, selection quote/copy & right-click paste.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格上下键历史回溯、双击 Esc 历史搜索、选中文本引用/自动复制与鼠标右键直接粘贴。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 15 obra/superpowers engineering skills, bilingual descriptions, per-skill toggles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：15 个 obra/superpowers 工程纪律技能，技能描述中英双语自由切换，每一个技能本身自由开关。

description.en: Remote and mobile access for DeepSeek Harness: provides LAN QR code connection, Cloudflare/custom tunnels, WeChat, QQ, Feishu, Telegram bot integration, and…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 远程与移动端接入插件：提供局域网扫码直连、Cloudflare 与自建公网隧道，以及微信、QQ、飞书、Telegram 机器人交互，内置安全认证与访问控制。

description.en: Topic grouping layered over the native workspace list: emoji folder groups, filtering and search, batch archive, and safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 在原生工作区列表之上叠加主题分组：emoji 分组文件夹、筛选与搜索、批量归档，以及带安全边界的永久删除。

description.en: Code preview for dsh-better-sidebar with per-language syntax highlighting, symbol outline, in-file search, and selection-to-conversation.

description.en: Durable background child agents on the official subagent seam: start from any session, watch progress in the Web UI sidebar, message and interrupt any time,…
