description.zh: 适用于 DSH 桌面端的液态玻璃 UI 美化插件，可与大部分壁纸插件联动使用，目前仅适配深色模式。

description.en: DSH balance and quota card showing up to 3 recently used providers. Supports DeepSeek, Moonshot, Kimi For Coding, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode Go, with…
description.zh: DSH 余额与配额悬浮卡片：常驻显示最近使用的最多 3 个 provider，支持 DeepSeek、Moonshot、Kimi For Coding、OpenAI Codex 和 OpenCode Go；自动发现配置，展示配额窗口与重置时间，并支持分档着色、拖动和自动刷新。

description.en: Local-life toolkit for DSH agents: budget planning, bill splitting, unit-price and discount math, common unit conversions (jin/li/chi, C/F, L/gallon), and trip…
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供本地生活工具包：预算规划、账单分摊、单价与折扣计算、常用单位换算（斤/里/尺、摄氏/华氏、升/加仑）与出行清单。

description.en: A study tab with course-map, tutor and blackboard columns that turns markdown files, local folders or GitHub repos into guided courses, with lesson unlocking,…
description.zh: 学习页签（课程｜导师｜黑板三栏）：把 markdown 文件、本地文件夹或 GitHub 仓库变成导学课程，提供课时解锁、掌握度追踪、间隔重复和导师设计式课程导入。

description.en: Plugin manager with a rescue center: grouped enable/disable by necessity, multi update sources (npm / dshfind market / GitHub), browser-first downloads with an…
description.zh: 插件管理器与救砖中心：按必要程度分组启停、多更新源（npm / 插件超市 / GitHub）、浏览器下载优先与目录自动安装、P2P 兜底、启动前自检与坏包隔离。

description.en: Adds a manual "mark as unread" action to workspace session rows, and retires itself once the harness exposes the same capability.
description.zh: 给工作区会话行补一个手动「标记为未读」；官方支持同能力后自动退休。

description.en: Browse and search GitHub dsh-plugin repositories from Web UI Settings, sort by stars, and install plugins through the DSH CLI.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 设置页浏览和搜索 GitHub dsh-plugin 仓库，按 Star 排序，并通过 DSH CLI 安装插件。

description.en: Matrix-style CLI chat page for the DSH web UI: the agent's thinking streams down the screen as green code rain while replies print normally in the terminal.
description.zh: 矩阵风格 CLI 对话页：Agent 思考过程化作绿色代码雨倾泻而下，回复照常流式显示。

description.en: Image and video wallpapers for the DSH web workspace: auto-detected GIF/APNG/animated WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM backgrounds with blur, brightness and dimming,…
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供图片/视频壁纸背景：GIF/APNG/动图 WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM 魔数自动识别，压暗/亮度/高斯模糊，界面色调与字体颜色自动跟随背景，各组件独立透明度，预置壁纸一键应用。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user…
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack…

description.en: Converts Mermaid flowcharts into GB/T 1526-1989 (ISO 5807) compliant SVG through one model-facing tool, with optional A4/A3 pagination.
description.zh: 把 Mermaid 流程图转成符合 GB/T 1526-1989（等同 ISO 5807）图形符号的 SVG，可选用 A4/A3 幅面自动分页。

description.en: Discovers other DSH instances on the local network by UDP multicast or port scan, lists them in a sidebar panel together with the capabilities each one…
description.zh: 通过 UDP 组播或端口扫描发现局域网内的其他 DSH 实例，在侧栏面板中列出它们以及各自上报的能力，并可经局域网或自动下载的用户态 Tailscale 节点在两台机器之间双向派发任务。

description.en: Edit a sent message to rewind and branch the conversation from that turn, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse every branch in a…
description.zh: 编辑已发送的消息即可从该轮次回溯并分叉对话，用气泡下方的计数器切换版本，并在轮次级版本树中浏览所有分支。

description.en: Card-style plugin manager in Settings: enable/disable each plugin through the profile patch layer, install-source details, npm update check with one-click…
description.zh: 设置页卡片式插件管理：经 profile 补丁层启停插件（跨重启保留）、安装来源详情、npm 更新检查与一键更新、卸载、搜索与加载失败标识。

description.en: AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the…
description.zh: 基于 Midscene 的 AI UI 自动化——android_ui 与 web_ui 工具，通过 ctx.midscene seam 在真实 Android 设备或已运行的 Chrome 上完成点击、输入、查询与断言。

description.en: Streams DeepSeek Harness sessions, messages, tool activity, and turn outcomes to a JARVIS Mission Control board with task status and human review.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话、消息、工具活动与每轮结果实时推送到 JARVIS Mission Control 看板，附任务状态与人工复核。

description.en: Token-authenticated REST and SSE bridge with QR pairing, so a phone app can read sessions, send messages and approve tool calls.
description.zh: 带令牌鉴权的 REST 与 SSE 接口，扫码配对后可在手机 App 上看会话、发消息、批准工具调用。

description.en: Authenticated mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: connects the companion native iOS client over WebSocket for sessions, live events, tasks, goals, approvals,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的设备鉴权移动网关：通过 WebSocket 连接配套原生 iOS 客户端，支持会话、实时事件、任务、Goal、审批、命令和文件传输，并提供二维码配对与设备撤销。

description.en: Host-side connector for the DSH Mobile iOS app: dials a self-hostable WSS relay so the phone can reach the DSH sessions on this computer over 4G/5G, without a…
description.zh: DSH Mobile 的电脑侧连接器：连上可自建的公网 WSS 中转，手机在 4G/5G 下即可访问这台电脑上的 DSH 会话，电脑不需要公网 IP 也不用组网；中转只做鉴权与转发。

description.en: Model Capability Manager for DSH Web: thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, gateway compat presets, EN/中文 UI.
description.zh: DSH 网页端模型能力管理插件：控制推理档位、上下文与输出上限、输入模态及网关兼容预设，双语界面。

description.en: Read-only Molio knowledge base tools: list vaults, browse the file tree, full-text search and read documents, served over the local Molio daemon HTTP API,…
description.zh: Molio 本地知识库只读工具集：列知识库、浏览文件树、全文搜索、读取原文，经本机 Molio daemon HTTP API 取数（需 daemon 常驻运行）。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-molio，dsh plugin add 即装。

description.en: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip,…
description.zh: 给 Agent 一张会说话的脸：七个工具驱动自托管的 Mynah 实时数字人——开口说话（排队或打断）、播放动作片段、打断、查看在线会话与频道、健康检查、往知识库加文本。

description.en: Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Icons are…
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件换自定义图标、中文显示名和一句话说明；用文件夹与收藏整理，支持拖拽排序、按备注名拼音排序、列表与铺陈两种视图。所有已安装插件自动分配图标（可手动覆盖）；导入导出覆盖图标、备注名、说明、文件夹与排序。只改显示，不修改插件文件与 cordis 配置；启用开关转调官方插件管理器。

description.en: Declares a spec-driven development agent preset with a Chinese persona and four static Claude Code/Codex delegation tools for planning, implementation, review…
description.zh: 声明规范驱动研发预设，包含中文人格与四个 Claude Code/Codex 静态委派工具，用于规划、实现、审查与知识提炼；角色由提示词引导，并非自动状态机。

description.en: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL…
description.zh: 自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表：Text2SQL、图表、报表收藏、Schema/数据面板与侧栏工作台，基于 DSH 的 MySQL 连接层。

description.en: Start and detach standalone chats without a mandatory workspace, keeping DSH's native workspace UI intact.
description.zh: 无需强制绑定工作区即可新建和分离独立会话，同时保留 DSH 原生的工作区界面。

description.en: Shows per-turn changes in cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, and maximum nesting depth for TypeScript, Python, and Go in the Web UI, with expandable…
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中展示每轮任务前后的圈复杂度、认知复杂度和最大嵌套深度变化，支持 TypeScript、Python 和 Go，可展开文件和函数查看详情，帮助确定代码审查重点。

description.en: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls…
description.zh: 通知出口：agent 主动通过桌面通知 / 中文语音 / 音效（炸裂、胜利、警报）联系你，60 秒确认窗口后语音呼叫，音量增强，设置面板。

description.en: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice…
description.zh: 按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

description.en: Native-style notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: a chime when the agent needs your decision or finishes a task, clickable system notifications that jump…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生风格提示音插件：智能体需要你决策或任务完成时播放提示音，点击系统通知可跳回窗口；支持重复提醒、静音时段，以及目标模式下只在最终轮提醒。

description.en: Converts Office and PDF files in the DSH workspace to Markdown locally — no network, no API quota — before the model reads them. Writes each .md next to its…
description.zh: 在模型读取之前，把工作区里的 Office / PDF 文件在本机转成 Markdown（不联网、不消耗 API 额度），.md 写在源文件旁边，因此进入上下文的只是一个文件路径，并返回字节数、行数、token 估算与标题结构索引，支持单个文件或整个目录。

description.en: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开 VS Code、终端和文件资源管理器。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling, weekly and monthly used and remaining percentage with reset times) in a floating panel anchored to the…
description.zh: 在会话窗口左下角的悬浮面板中显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（滚动/每周/每月的已用与剩余百分比及重置时间）。

description.en: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed…
description.zh: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。

description.en: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, ideas board, dependency graph, review timeline and an install entry for the project of the current…
description.zh: 把 orchd 项目状态带进 DSH 右侧栏的只读面板：任务看板、想法看板、依赖图、审查时间线与接入入口，只跟当前会话的项目。

description.en: Pre-install compatibility gate for DSH plugins: locks the resolved version, checks peer/engines declarations, dry-installs into an isolated DSH_HOME and boots…
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前兼容性门控：锁定解析版本、校验 peer/engines 声明、在隔离 DSH_HOME 中试装并限时试启动，任一失败即阻止；正式安装失败自动还原 profile。可选拦截 dsh-market 的安装/更新点击，兼容 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x。

description.en: Global proxy for DeepSeek Harness: route agent tools, model requests and web fetches through the Windows system proxy or a custom address with one persistent…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全局代理插件：通过 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址统一代理模型请求与工具流量，主界面常驻开关，且 Agent 在对话中实时感知代理状态。

description.en: Replaces the Windows pwsh executor row so the model-facing pwsh tool runs PowerShell 7, with a shell_router tool for status, diagnosis, and per-user portable…
description.zh: 在 Windows 上替换 pwsh 执行器行，让模型侧 pwsh 工具运行 PowerShell 7，并提供 shell_router 工具做状态、诊断与用户级便携安装。

description.en: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.
description.zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

description.en: Third-party adapter that registers the upstream REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as mcp__rea__* tools. 2.x provisions its own…
description.zh: 第三方适配插件：把上游 REA（逆向一切，github.com/morluto/rea）的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 工具。2.x 自带供给：把 Node、REA CLI、JDK、Ghidra 装到 <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle…

description.en: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into…
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

description.en: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons…
description.zh: DSH 插件推荐器：按需求描述、分类与标签在 1100+ 条内嵌市场目录中搜索并排序插件，返回匹配理由，支持从 awesome-dsh-plugin README 在线刷新目录。

description.en: Role-based plugin recommender for DSH: asks the user's role (developer, designer, writer, researcher, ops, student...), recommends suitable plugins, and audits…
description.zh: 按职业/角色推荐 DSH 插件：询问用户是做什么的（程序员、设计师、写作、研究、运维、学生…），推荐适合的插件，并对每个插件做本地静态安全审计（危险代码模式 + 0-100 风险分）与口碑检查（npm 下载量 / GitHub 星数）。

description.en: In-place redaction and row-level rollback for session logs, preserving the seq-equals-row-index invariant that makes deleting a middle row corrupt the entire…
description.zh: 会话日志的原地脱敏与按行回退：守住「每行 seq 必须等于它的行号」这一不变式（删中间行会让整份日志打不开）。任何写入前先把原文复制成隔离备份，并以读取端自身的语义作为写前闸门。

description.en: Exposes the local DSH web GUI to one chosen CIDR range only (Tailscale by default) instead of binding 0.0.0.0: the proxy listens on addresses inside that…
description.zh: 只把本机 DSH 网页界面开放给指定的一个网段（默认 Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10），不绑 0.0.0.0：网段外的对端一律拒绝，进入方式可选带票网址或 4–12 位数字/字母访问密码；远程页面可强制手机布局而不动本机界面，官方「通用设置」里的外观 / 字号大小 / 工作步骤展示 /…

description.en: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard…
description.zh: 浏览工作区 origin 远端对应的 GitHub issue 与 pull request，筛选、评论、关闭或重开，并可转成任务写到 dsh-plugin-taskboard 的看板上等 agent 领取。

description.en: Agent-facing plugin installer that resolves DSH-compatible versions, handles ambiguous names, and verifies the loader entry after install.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的插件安装器：解析 DSH 兼容版本、处理同名歧义，并在安装后校验 loader 入口。

description.en: Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file…
description.zh: 仅 Windows。DSH 插件变动后提示重启，一键静默重启（全程无命令提示符窗口），并可展开本次改动的逐行差异。

description.en: Restores the DSH right sidebar divider drag after whole-interface zoom shifts the host handle off it, and widens the hit area to 12px with a hover affordance.
description.zh: 修复整页缩放后右侧栏拖拽手柄偏移、分割线拖不动的问题，把命中区加宽到 12px 并显示悬停提示线。

description.en: Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how…
description.zh: 检测账号当前被分配到哪个对话模型：并发发起一次性探测会话，按段落开头的写法为流式思维链打分，读起来像旧模型的在数秒内中止。附带离线自检，用同一分类器回放 13 条人工标注的思维链。

description.en: Plugin inventory manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: table view of installed plugins with status filters, enable/disable switches applied via HMR, config…
description.zh: DSH 插件总览（逃咪）：以表格视图管理已安装插件，支持状态过滤、HMR 热生效的启停开关、配置查看/复制、卸载与 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line…
description.zh: 可逆的上下文瘦身插件：均匀 JSON 数组走 TOON 式无损表格化重编码，管道表按行号抽样保留窗口，90 秒内字节级相同的工具输出跨轮去重；每次替换都要通过双重门（压缩后 ≤72% 字节且估算 token 严格下降），原文落盘并以 `[save-token #id]` 标记，可用…

description.en: Live estimated session spend in the composer dock, pricing each assistant step at DeepSeek's peak or off-peak rate for its own timestamp.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前会话的预估花费，每一步都按其自身时间戳采用 DeepSeek 的峰时或非峰时单价计价。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode…
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good…
description.zh: 两步删除会话：会话菜单先把会话移入回收站（不删任何内容、可随时恢复），面板可恢复、可逐条立刻删除、也可整体清空，下次启动 DSH 时才真正清掉日志、投影缓存、spill 文件与工作区登记。

description.en: Turn a set of DSH plugins into one pasteable share code, then install it plugin by plugin — with a QR code to carry it to a phone.
description.zh: 把一套 DSH 插件变成一段可粘贴的分享码，别人贴进去就能逐条安装，也能生成二维码带到手机上。

description.en: Opening animation, three bundled wallpapers, up to nine uploaded wallpapers with random rotation, and live panel and sidebar opacity.
description.zh: 开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多九张上传壁纸与随机轮换，以及实时生效的面板与侧边栏透明度。

description.en: DSH settings section for managing a local Sirchmunk knowledge backend: graph inspection, cluster management, audit history, runtime metrics, and privacy…
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理本地 Sirchmunk 知识库：图谱导出、聚类管理、审计历史、运行指标与隐私控制。

description.en: Run one deterministic skill-routing pass on every user instruction, so the skill catalog is consulted before the model answers instead of after it remembers.…
description.zh: 对每条用户指令自动做一次确定性的技能路由，让技能目录在模型作答之前就被查阅，而不是等它自己想起来。宿主侧只依据指令关键词与目录元数据打分，不调用 LLM 也不做向量检索，然后向该步追加恰好一条带生产者标签的消息：默认是候选排名简报，分数过线时改注入冠军技能的 SKILL.md…

description.en: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

description.en: Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool…

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过 OAuth 检索你的 Quberi 知识库中的文档和图片，浏览空间和文档，保存笔记，并上传文件（每个文件都需你确认）。

description.en: Adds an optional note field under each selected option in the DSH Web UI ask_user_question popup; submitted notes travel to the model in the answer's custom…
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页端 ask_user_question 弹窗中为每个选中选项增加可选的补充说明输入框，提交时补充内容随答案一并传给模型。

description.en: Tree-style questioning for DSH: click "Ask in tree" on a selection to add a node to the right-sidebar tree and ask inline under it; clicking another node makes…
description.zh: 对话里划取文字后点「树形提问」，右栏问题树就多一个节点，问题直接写在节点下；单击别的节点就把它设为当前节点，之后再划取默认挂在它下面，「Alt + 树形提问」新开根节点，「Ctrl + 树形提问」把新段落追加进同一节点；双击节点跳回原文，点左侧圆点标记「懂了」；右上角可在列表与横向分支图之间切换。划取后点「添加到对话」…

description.en: A simple DSH queue panel for editing, removing, steering, reordering, and bulk removal.
description.zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

description.en: Reorder the messages queued while a DSH agent is busy, from inside the official queue dock: a drag handle and per-row ↑ / ↓ buttons on the dock's own rows,…
description.zh: 在官方队列 dock 内直接重排忙碌时排队的消息：每一行带拖拽手柄与上下移动按钮，移动在宿主端以一次带并发校验的 inbox splice 完成。只装饰官方 dock 而不替换它，因此预览、行内编辑、插话、删除与附件保持原样。队列已变化、该行不是用户消息（例如目标轮次提示）、或队列属于子代理会话时，移动会被拒绝。

description.en: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每个由会话支持的消息编辑器旁提供全局快捷动作。一键发送预置或你自己保存的文本，每个动作可单独设置发送确认。

description.en: ChatGPT-style side chat for the DSH Web GUI: ask small questions about the current topic in a floating side panel, answered by an independent lightweight…
description.zh: ChatGPT 式侧边快速提问：在 DSH Web 聊天界面右侧悬浮面板中就当前话题提小问题，由独立轻量会话通过官方 /api RPC 回答，绝不写入、不影响主对话。流式正文、可折叠思考、工具 chips、停止按钮、agent 预设选择，自动抓取主对话最近内容作为背景。

description.en: A 3×3 pad of saved phrases sitting to the left of the composer and tracking the input box's height: clicking a cell inserts its text at the caret as one…
description.zh: 输入框左侧的九宫格快捷短语面板，高度跟随输入框：点一格就把该条短语以一次可撤销的编辑插入光标处；面板内可就地编辑，每页 9 格、最多 12 页，界面跟随 DSH 语言设置。窗口放不下时退回输入框上方浮层。

description.en: Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment…
description.zh: Web GUI 的快速打开面板：Ctrl+P 在会话工作区的内存索引上做模糊检索（约 5.1 万条目，查询中位数 5 ms），支持逐段路径锚定、dir: 与 file: 前缀、Tab 目录下钻与 :行号 跳转；选中文件走 DSH 原生右栏打开，Ctrl+Enter 把文件引用放进会话草稿。另为内置文件预览补上文件内查找…

description.en: Adds a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a precise prompt in place, in one click, with a revert action.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，点一下就把草稿原地改写成精确提示词，可一键恢复原文。

description.en: Manageable one-tap text chips above the session composer; idle sessions queue the message and running sessions steer at the next safe boundary without…
description.zh: 在会话输入区上方提供可管理的一点即发文本 chip；空闲时 queue、运行中 steer，不改写草稿。

description.en: Conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: the Markdown headings of the whole session, grouped by turn, in a side panel or a full-width curtain; hover previews…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话大纲：按回合整理整段会话的 Markdown 标题，侧边面板与全屏「幕布」两种视图；悬停预览可钉住对照，书签留住常回看的几处，右键即可跳转到某一节或复制标题及其下面所有层级。支持六种主题色与半透明材质、标题/提问/全文/跨会话搜索、阅读位置跟随与中英双语界面。

description.en: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog…
description.zh: 將「新增工作區」流程中喺主機彈出嘅資料夾選擇器，改成輸入名稱嘅對話框，令遠端瀏覽器可以直接建立並開啟工作區。

description.en: Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter,…
description.zh: 开发者速查工具箱：12 个主题 195 条速查 + 6 个零依赖工具（正则实时测试、JSON 格式化、时间戳转换、Base64/URL 编解码、Cron 生成、行 diff），设置页可搜索查阅。

description.en: Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).
description.zh: 纯文本模型双层识图：优先本地快速 OCR（RapidOCR，离线），不足时回落视觉模型（modlens）。

description.en: System-level desktop floating-window plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a global hotkey opens a floating window; the plugin supports workspace and session…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的系统级桌面悬浮窗插件：按下全局快捷键即可呼出桌面悬浮窗口，支持工作区与会话切换、审批与追问处理，以及插件自身的诊断日志导出。

description.en: Bottom-right quota pill and panel aggregating membership quotas across AI platforms (Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Zhipu Coding Plan, BigModel, Qwen, Scnet,…
description.zh: 右下角「会员额度」悬浮球与面板，聚合各 AI 平台套餐额度（Kimi Code、DeepSeek、智谱 Coding Plan、BigModel、通义千问、超算、TokenRouter、SupaWriter），API key 自动同步自 DSH 凭证域，彩色进度条展示用量。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage…
description.zh: 侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章：数字滚轮动画、多币种支持、余额趋势图、按 Key 用量统计（含安装前历史回填），并支持 GitHub 版本自动检查。

description.en: Bottom-right quota capsule that auto-discovers every configured provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, GLM, one-api/new-api, coding plans) and shows…
description.zh: 右下角额度胶囊：自动发现所有已配置 Key 的供应商（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、GLM、one-api/new-api、各类 Coding 套餐），显示余额或 5 小时/周滚动用量，支持按供应商设置可见性、告警阈值与代理；另支持火山方舟 Agent Plan / Coding…

description.en: Select response text or code to ask contextual follow-ups with streaming replies in a native sidebar.
description.zh: 选中回答里的文字或代码，在原生侧边栏中结合上下文实时追问。

description.en: Adds selection quoting and anchored annotations to DSH conversations: selected text enters the composer as an anchored quote reference, a quote bar jumps back…
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话添加选区引用与锚点批注：选中文字带锚点进入输入框，输入框下方的引用条可跳回原文并高亮，发送后的引用块标明出处轮次与角色。

description.en: Quote selected conversation text into the Web composer as native reference chips for focused follow-up turns.
description.zh: 在网页会话中划选文本，以原生引用 chip 插入输入框，进行针对性追问。

description.en: Qwen Token Plan CN Responses provider for DeepSeek Harness via the OpenAI Responses API, with Qwen server-side tools, DSH local function tools,…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的千问 Token Plan 个人版 Responses API 提供方，保留 Qwen 服务端内置工具与 DSH 本地函数工具，多轮文本/推理/工具调用历史与图片附件均被支持，官方模型目录按 npm 版本冻结快照发布。

description.en: Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the…
description.zh: 针对 NInfer 托管的 qwen3.8-27b 网关的压缩修复：在 dsh 上下文压缩与会话标题调用中关闭思考，避免 xhigh 推理耗尽全部输出预算；同一思路适用于其他启动方式，本包仅面向 NInfer。

description.en: Adds DSH 0.2.x kernel support to the SenseTime XiaoHuanXiong desktop-app models, reusing that app's stored sign-in so no API key is needed.
description.zh: 为商汤小浣熊桌面 App 的模型补上 DSH 0.2.x 内核支持，复用该 App 的登录态，无需填写 API Key。

description.en: Read-only Raindrop.io dashboard in the sidebar with collection and tag distribution, top source domains, content types, a 12-month trend and a cleanup backlog,…
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Raindrop.io 只读仪表盘：分类与标签分布、域名来源 Top、内容类型、近 12 个月趋势与待清理项，并提供两个只读 Agent 工具分析收藏。需 Raindrop.io API token（创建应用后粘贴）。

description.en: Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile,…
description.zh: 逆向分析工作台：通过 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 把本机 IDA Pro 桥接进 DSH，将 ida-pro-mcp 工具集（反编译、xref、重命名、注释）以 mcp__ida__* 注册给模型。自动选择 idalib 无头模式（进程内分析二进制，无需打开 IDA GUI）或 GUI…

description.en: Pinned-version REA for DeepSeek Harness: installs rea-agents locally, starts its MCP server from that pinned copy, and upgrades only when you press Update.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 固定版本的 REA：把 rea-agents 安装到当前配置档的一个确切版本，从该副本启动其 MCP 服务，只有按下「更新」才升级。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against morluto/rea over stdio, for reverse engineering anything with agents, from…
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥，经 stdio 连接 morluto/rea，让 agent 从应用行为一路逆向到底层原生二进制。

description.en: Installs and verifies the reverse-engineering engines REA needs on Windows (Ghidra, JADX, apktool, adb, WABT, frida and more), pins the rea-agents MCP server…
description.zh: 在 Windows 上安装并校验 REA 所需的逆向引擎（Ghidra、JADX、apktool、adb、WABT、frida 等），固定 rea-agents 的 MCP 服务版本，并在设置卡片里体检能力缺口。

description.en: Pushes DSH approval and question cards to IM channels (WeChat first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push…
description.zh: 把 DSH 的审批卡与提问卡推送到 IM 渠道（先支持微信），可在聊天里直接作答，带会话控制台、逐渠道安全与开放推送服务。

description.en: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine,…
description.zh: 在每条已定稿的助手回复里、紧挨点赞按钮右侧加一个小喇叭：点击用浏览器语音引擎朗读这条回复，鼠标悬停可调倍速与音色；文本会发送到非官方的 Edge TTS 端点。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices and highlights the sentence being spoken, so you can follow along while listening. The…
description.zh: 用微软 Edge 神经音色朗读助手回复，并高亮当前正在朗读的那一句，可以边听边看。高亮样式完全自定义：底色、文字颜色、浓淡三样都能在设置里调。另外每条回复下方有音浪播放键、暂停与上句/下句跳转、语速调节和自动朗读开关。

description.en: Reads animated GIF and WebP as animations: a pasted one keeps playing in the UI while the model gets a labelled sheet of frames sampled across it, and the…
description.zh: 把 gif 和动图 webp 当作动画来读：贴进聊天框的照常播放，模型收到的是横跨整段采样、带帧号与时长的胶片条；工作区里的文件由 read_animation 按需采样。

description.en: Deterministic prompt-injection interception: tool results from file reads, repo searches and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context;…
description.zh: 确定性注入拦截：文件读取、仓库搜索与网络抓取的工具结果在进入模型上下文前被扫描；高危发现隔离包裹或阻断，凭证类文件按路径即隔离。

description.en: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 和桌面版展示 read_image 结果：完整预览、多图画廊、透明棋盘格、键盘与触控缩放，使用会话授权加载。已验证 DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Read any page as clean main content: charset auto-detect (GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5), noise stripping, compact text/Markdown, offset continuation, optional SPA…
description.zh: 读取网页返回干净正文：中文编码自动识别（GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5）、噪音过滤、紧凑文本/Markdown、offset 续读、可选 SPA 渲染、批量读取与整站爬取。

description.en: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache…
description.zh: 为 DSH read 工具提供版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存：未变更文件的重复读取跳过文件 I/O 与行渲染，附带 readcache 工具查看统计与清空。

description.en: Realtime Avatar (realtimeavatar.ai) for agents: the developer API key held by the harness credentials store, the public docs as five on-demand skills, rta_*…
description.zh: Realtime Avatar（realtimeavatar.ai）实时数字人工具：开发者 API key 由 harness 凭据存储保管，公开文档打包为五个按需加载的技能，rta_* 工具封装公开 REST API（余额、数字人、动作片段、会话、用量），消耗额度的操作需审批，/rta…

description.en: Distill over-long model reasoning into its useful core, replay the compressed version on every later request, and report each session's cost and savings.…
description.zh: 把过长的模型思考压缩成有用核心，之后每次请求重放压缩版，并给出每个会话的开销与节省报告。默认关闭：必须先选择一个改写后端。derive 无需安装、打包版也能用；in-place 需给 DSH 源码打 14 处补丁并重建（源码构建首选）；message-edit 需装第三方插件，仅实验性，不推荐。

description.en: Configures provider and model reasoning-effort mappings for DeepSeek Harness, with a grouped model picker and composer slider.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置 Provider 与模型的推理强度映射，并提供按 Provider 分组的模型选择器和输入框滑块。

description.en: Add missing reasoning-effort declarations to custom pi-ai models through DSH settings, enabling the native effort picker and handling models added later.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 设置为自定义 pi-ai 模型补充缺失的推理强度声明，启用原生强度选择器，并自动处理后续添加的模型。

description.en: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.
description.zh: 为模型添加推理强度滑块，支持原生与动画模式、明暗配色，以及全局或按模型配色。

description.en: Declares per-model reasoning-effort ladders for third-party providers in the llm-pi-ai settings section, so DSH's stock thinking-intensity selector works on…
description.zh: 在 llm-pi-ai 设置节为第三方模型提供商补齐推理档位（reasoning effort）声明，让 DSH 自带的思考强度选择器对 pi-ai 目录之外的模型真正可用。

description.en: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never…
description.zh: 对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

description.en: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a…
description.zh: 消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

description.en: Adds a strip above the composer that lists sent-but-unread (steering) text messages and recalls them before the model reads them, one by one or all at once.
description.zh: 在输入框上方列出已发送但模型尚未读取的插话消息，可在模型读取前逐条或一次性撤回。

description.en: Summarizes the current DeepSeek Harness session with /recap or after inactivity, with configurable models, Chinese and English output, and expandable summaries…
description.zh: 通过 /recap 或闲置触发回顾当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持配置模型、中英文输出，并在对话内展示可展开的摘要。

description.en: Draggable recent-deliverables panel for DSH Web that merges declared deliverables with recently modified workspace files, with filename search, type filters,…
description.zh: DSH Web 的可拖动最近成品面板，合并已声明交付的文件与工作区最近修改的文件，支持文件名搜索、类型筛选、PDF/HTML/图片/文本内嵌预览，以及用桌面应用打开或在文件管理器中定位。

description.en: An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里常驻末位、可折叠的「最近任务」工作区分组：侧边栏入口与 Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N 快捷键在专用目录里开新对话，对话因此归入这个分组，而不是「未分组」。该分组是真正的工作区记录，而非插件画出来的仿制品，折叠、改名、搜索与拖拽排序都正常可用；目录、分组名、常驻末尾与自动重建都是实时设置…

description.en: A deterministic calculation engine for DeepSeek Harness, including a preset that guides the LLM to calculate through the engine rather than by text generation.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性计算引擎，附带一个预设：引导 LLM 通过引擎而非文本生成来完成计算。

description.en: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools…
description.zh: DSH 插件透明排行与推荐：每日自动抓取 `dsh-plugin` 话题生态，公开评分模型，提供 rank/search/recommend 工具与设置页榜单。

description.en: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.
description.zh: 回退到任意一条提问之前，或编辑上一条问题重新提交；被丢弃轮次产生的工作区文件会一并还原。

description.en: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation…
description.zh: DSH 重启后自动续跑被中断的回合：在会话激活后读取崩溃修复写入的 turn/end，投出要求先核对真实状态（不假定外部操作成功或失败）的续跑消息；永久性失败（认证、配额、上下文超限）直接跳过，并有跨重启次数预算、自适应退避与最小上下文注入。

description.en: Delete DSH sessions into a restorable recycle bin — subagent sessions follow their parent as one tree, batch archive, restore and purge are supported, and only…
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话删入可恢复的回收站——子会话随其父会话作为一棵树处理，支持批量归档、恢复与彻底删除，只有彻底清除才会真正销毁数据。

description.en: Adds Regenerate and Edit and resend to each message you already sent: Regenerate re-answers the same text in one click without going through the composer; Edit…
description.zh: 给你发出的每条消息加上「重新生成」和「编辑重发」：重新生成一键用同样的文字重新回答，不经过输入框；编辑重发就地撤回这条消息及其之后的内容——从时间线和模型上下文里一起消失，不新建会话也不开新分支——再把文字和图片放回输入框，改完发送就从那一条重写对话。带文件（非图片）的消息两个操作置灰。

description.en: Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling,…

description.en: Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.
description.zh: 基于 dsh 内置 Web 服务管理、浏览与播放本地媒体库，完美适配 PC 与移动端，支持手势上下滑动刷视频、即时拖拽秒播与实时转码。

description.en: Turn codebase smells into an executable, priority-ordered refactoring plan: file-length / deep-nesting / function-length / god-object heuristics plus a staged…
description.zh: 重构入口诊断：把代码库坏味道（超长文件/深嵌套/超长函数/上帝对象）转成带定位、优先级与依赖顺序的重构计划（只读不自动改码）。

description.en: Reference workspace files, DSH sessions, and historical ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Kimi conversations from the unified DSH @ menu.
description.zh: 从 DSH 统一的 @ 菜单中引用工作区文件、DSH 会话，以及 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok 和 Kimi 的历史对话。

description.en: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text)…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供参考文献真实性检查：reference_checker 工具将论文（PDF/BibTeX/tex/文本/粘贴列表）的每条文献对照 Crossref / OpenAlex / arXiv 核对，逐条判定 found / partial / not_found /…

description.zh: DSH 会话原文只读投影同步器（drsc）：只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions/** 会话日志，经内置 leaf 解码器解 zstd/分段帧日志后投影进插件自有 SQLite（node:sqlite，segments/replaces + FTS5），由单条 fenced HTTP 路由提供 surface…

description.en: Reflex arc for DS Bot: runs as a sibling DSH plugin with no change to ds-bot, collects facts in cheap layers, scores them with a local decision model, and…
description.zh: 给 DS Bot 的反射弧：作为兄弟插件运行、不改 ds-bot，用低成本层持续采集事实并在本地决策模型上打分，只有越过阈值时才唤醒 Bot 的推理层。

description.en: Make F5, Ctrl+F5, and Ctrl+Shift+R reload the DeepSeek Harness page.
description.zh: 让 F5、Ctrl+F5 和 Ctrl+Shift+R 都能刷新 DeepSeek Harness 页面。

description.en: Adds F5 / Ctrl+R page reload to the DeepSeek Harness desktop web UI, which production builds lack by default (the "Reload Page" menu item and bare-F5…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Web UI 补上 F5 / Ctrl+R 页面刷新功能（生产版默认没有刷新菜单项与裸 F5 快捷键）。通过客户端捕获阶段按键监听绑定软刷新（F5、Ctrl+R）与防缓存硬刷新（F5 加修饰键、Ctrl+Shift+R，附加 _dsh_refresh 时间戳）。

description.en: Adds two buttons beside the sidebar toggle at the top-left of the DSH desktop UI, on macOS, Windows and Linux. Reload refreshes only the UI layer while a turn…
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版界面左上角「收起侧边栏」按钮旁加两个按钮，macOS、Windows、Linux 三端都可用。刷新只重载界面层，宿主里正在生成的回合不中断；重启会在确认一次后退出整个应用并自动重新打开，会话与工作区都在。重启是 POST，必须带每次启动随机生成的 token（由插件状态接口提供）；插件不联网、不读会话…

description.en: Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and…
description.zh: 在下载超时或失败时，于 npmmirror 国内镜像与官方 npm 源之间自动切换下载源，并附带 Web UI 可手动查看与切换。

description.en: Hot reload and one-click restart for DSH plugin development. Reload uses DSH's built-in reload instead of a private reimplementation, so it behaves the way the…
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发的热重载与一键重启。重载用 DSH 自带的重载，而不是另造一套，所以行为和宿主一致：只刷新有改动的插件，其余继续运行。重启是安全的那个：跑在客户端之外，所以即使要换掉的正是客户端本身也能重新拉起；有会话或后台任务在跑时直接拒绝；并确认客户端真的重新打开了。轻量：只多一个工具、不带参数、不向模型上下…

description.en: Multi-machine remote workspace: manage many SSH hosts, pick a local or remote workspace in the native Add-workspace flow (system folder chooser / local path /…
description.zh: 多机远程工作区：管理多台 SSH 主机，在原生「添加工作区」流程里选本机系统文件夹或远程目录，把远程工作区镜像成真实本地文件夹并用 rw_* 工具操作。选择器是居中弹窗，默认落在本机页签，远程路径自动预填 `/` 并逐级自动补全目录。

description.en: Turn another computer into a remote Agent teammate: the worker runs its own DSH and a full Agent loop locally, so dispatched tasks keep running when the link…
description.zh: 把另一台电脑变成你的远程 Agent 同事：副机本地跑自己的 DSH 与完整 Agent 循环，所以链路断开时任务照常继续、模型凭证也永不离开那台机器。主机用 8 个 remote_* 工具派活，只收回 handoff 摘要与产物清单，成品按需拉取——中间产物留在副机。配对码接入，direct 或 relay…

description.en: DSH remote-access authorization page that shows the current process browser-session URL as a clickable link or QR code, behind an optional authority/subnet…
description.zh: DSH 远程授权页：以可点击链接或二维码呈现当前进程的浏览器会话 URL，可选主机/网段白名单与 PIN 门禁。

description.en: Bot-to-bot messaging across machines on top of ds-harness-remote: five tools let a local Bot list the peer Host Bots, pin a target device and send it a…
description.zh: 基于 ds-harness-remote 的跨机器 Bot 传话：五个工具让本地 Bot 列出对端 Bot、固定目标设备并给它发消息，不用切换本地窗口。

description.en: Translates DSH's private remote protocol into a versioned REST API (chat, sessions, files, devices) for trusted clients such as the Android app dsh-companion,…
description.zh: 把 DSH 内核的私有 remote 协议翻译成版本化 REST 接口（聊天、会话、文件、设备），供 Android 客户端 dsh-companion 等受信任客户端使用；桌面端在 DSH 设置里内联渲染七张折叠卡片（根目录 / 远程访问 / 设备 / 识图 / 回收站 / 审计 / App 下载）。

description.en: Adds a row at the top of the sidebar that switches the whole Web GUI to another DSH host reached over a loopback port, and shows that host's session state on…
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部加一行，点击后整页切换成另一台 DSH 主机的 Web GUI（通过回环端口访问），并在该行显示那台主机的会话状态（运行中、有新活动、正等你回答）。

description.en: Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM…
description.zh: 远程开发启动器：通过 SSH（或本机 WSL 发行版）在远端引导安装 dsh，从本地客户端连接，LLM 凭据经反向隧道代理、不离开本机。同时提供独立 CLI 与 dsh 插件双形态，插件含远程会话面板、/remote-explorer 命令及 remote_* agent 工具。

description.en: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an…
description.zh: 模型可直接调用的 ssh 远程文件三件套：read_remote 按行号分页读远端 UTF-8 文本，write_remote 只新建文件、目标已存在即拒绝且没有覆写分支，edit_remote 做唯一匹配的字面替换，三者共用取自 ~/.ssh/config 的「别名:路径」一个 file_path 字段。

description.en: Embeds a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, lists the remote sessions, and switches between the local instance and any…
description.zh: 通过 SSH 隧道把远端 DSH 的 GUI 嵌进本地 DSH 界面，列出远端会话，并在本地实例与任意远端主机之间切换。

description.en: Native SSH remote development for DSH: remote workspaces, mirrored sessions, terminal and file access, approvals, and a DSH UI. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2…
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机上的工作区接入 DSH：远程工作区、镜像会话、终端与文件访问、审批和原生 DSH 界面。需 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，远端主机为 Linux 或 macOS。

description.en: Remote & mobile security gateway: zero-modification Tailscale/LAN access with QR pairing, RSA encryption, brute-force defense and mobile style snippets;…
description.zh: 远程与移动端安全网关：零改动 DSH 底层代码开放 Tailscale/局域网访问，支持扫码配对、RSA 加密、防暴力破解与移动端样式片段；与其他远程插件共存时自动让出共享配对服务，避免启动崩溃。

description.en: Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app…
description.zh: 移动远程控制套件：原生侧边栏入口 + 管理抽屉的 bundle 插件，自带 Bearer 令牌网关自愈（局域网/Tailscale）；Android App 覆盖会话/审批/提问/goal；/fs/* 文件端点（Range 断点续传、2GB 上传）；多服务器测速自动切换；聊天记录离线缓存。

description.en: Bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH, SFTP, Telnet, and WinRM remote operations, with an encrypted credential vault whose login and execution scripts…
description.zh: 打包 remote-shell 技能，提供安全的 SSH、SFTP、Telnet、WinRM 远程操作，内置加密凭证库，登录与执行脚本不接受明文密码。

description.en: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and…
description.zh: 远程主机隧道管理器：把 dsh web 跑在远程 Linux 服务器上（systemd 守护、免 root），本地经自动重连的 SSH 隧道访问；远程端口自动分配并在服务器登记留档，支持多人共用与 audit 审查。

description.en: Ships a skill plus six Node scripts for a DSH install that will not come up - walking the boot stages before readiness, the plugin dependency bridges and…

description.en: Edits assistant replies and thinking chains in DSH sessions so the model sees the edited text, live via message projection or on disk.
description.zh: 编辑 DSH 会话中的助手回复与思维链，让模型采信改后的内容：在线经 message projection 立即生效，或落盘改写会话记录。

description.en: Read-only repository fact scanner kernel for DSH analysis plugins: deterministic probe / file index / modules / dependencies / entry points / symbols / graphs…

description.en: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.

description.en: Add your own parameters to the model requests dsh sends: OpenRouter provider routing and fallback models, reasoning, sampling and custom body fields, and…
description.zh: 给 dsh 发出的模型请求加上自己的参数：OpenRouter 供应商路由和备用模型、思考强度、采样参数与自定义请求体字段、请求头，OpenRouter 和其他网关都能用。参数按 dsh 已配置的渠道管理；实时预览显示每个请求会多出什么，请求记录显示实际发出了什么、网关回了什么。

description.en: Runtime requirement drift guard that keeps long-running DSH agents aligned with the user's approved goal, constraints, and decisions.
description.zh: 运行时需求漂移防护，在长任务执行过程中保持 DSH Agent 与用户确认的目标、约束和决策一致。

description.en: Curated research plugin market: adds a Research plugins page to Settings with hand-reviewed plugins for literature search, reference management, writing and…
description.zh: 精选科研插件市场：在设置里加一页「科研插件」，收录逐个读过代码的文献检索、文献管理、写作与科研工作台插件——一键安装、更新、卸载并钉住审读过的版本，面板内重启，只发一个网络请求（拉取自家目录）。

description.en: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness with a content-addressed evidence ledger, versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可核查研究报告引擎：通过内容寻址的证据台账和版本化封存报告使每条结论携带核查结论，由 manifest 哈希封存目录，检索编排复用 ctx.web 与 ctx.jobs 接口。

description.en: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
description.zh: DSH 重启插件：可配置的重启方式（Node 原生/旧 PowerShell 适配）、重启后自动继续的提示词、可选看门狗自动拉起。

description.zh: 在「设置」上方添加「重启 dsh」按钮，原地重启：以 systemd 单元运行时由 systemd 重启，否则通过 process.execve 保持同一 PID（Windows 或 Node < 22.15 时保留一个轻量父进程），启动 dsh 的守护进程或终端无需额外配置（已在 Linux…

description.en: Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版侧边栏添加「重启」按钮：结束整个应用进程树并重新打开应用。

description.en: One-click restart for the DSH desktop client, from five entries you can toggle individually: a sidebar panel, the sidebar footer, the conversation header, a…
description.zh: DSH 桌面版一键重启，五个入口可逐项开关：侧栏面板、侧栏底部、会话标题栏、设置 → 通用行、斜杠命令 /restart。只给主进程发关闭信号让宿主优雅退出（会话日志得以下盘），再由脱离进程树的助手自动拉起；可选守卫会等待进行中的任务或插件安装结束，重启结果写成回执，动作请求仅限本机同源，所有开关落 profile…

description.en: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working…

description.en: Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories /…

description.en: Recall, edit-and-resend and regenerate, plus in-conversation versioning: a timeline of every rewind, artifact rollback (git-first, snapshot fallback), a fork…

description.en: Observes consecutive identical tool failures and optionally pauses before the next model step, preserving original results and successful repeats, with an…

description.zh: 基于文献和实验结果的生物医学研究图谱，拆分假设，连接证据，推进研究。

description.en: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins that scores a repo or npm package across install success, maintenance activity, documentation…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供多指标质量评分：基于真实的 CLI 证据对某个仓库或 npm 包在安装成功率、维护活跃度、文档完整度、安全扫描和协议合规五个维度打分，并生成 JSON 或 Markdown 排行榜报告。

description.en: Evidence-driven company and job due-diligence for DSH: logs sources with evidence levels, adds evidence-bounded claims, verifies the legal entity against…
description.zh: 证据驱动的公司与岗位尽调插件：登记带证据等级的来源、添加受证据边界约束的结论、用官方登记信息核验公司主体，并生成推进/核验/停止三态报告，附核验清单与面试问题。

description.en: Fetches any http/https page and returns title, description, main text, heading outline and links, with stats (char/word counts, reading time, language) and top…
description.zh: 抓取任意 http/https 网页，提取标题、描述、正文、标题结构与链接，输出字符/词数、阅读时长、语言等统计与高频关键词；支持下载内容图片到会话工作区供视觉分析，并通过 scrape.imageAnalyzer 服务分发给已注册的识图分析器。

description.en: Diverts operation-script writes out of the workspace into a per-session scratch root and collects each one into an inspectable vault outside the workspace, so…
description.zh: 把操作腳本的寫入導出工作區、改放各 session 的暫存根，並把每一支收進工作區外的可檢視收納庫，讓工作區只留下真正的交付物。

description.en: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.
description.zh: 免工作区自由对话，产物自动提升为独立项目工作区；dsh-scratchpad 的持续维护 fork，跟当前 DSH 保持可用。

description.en: Point-and-shoot screenshot capture: a system floating window turns a new screenshot (or copied image) into an Obsidian note with comments and key-point…
description.zh: 指哪拍哪截图入库：系统级悬浮窗把新截图（或复制图片）一键存入 Obsidian 笔记，支持注释与「重点」标记、用宿主 DSH 多模态模型即时识别文字（零配置、无需另配 key，可回落通义千问）、同屏去重、按天合并，并可在晚间用 AI 整理归类、打双链并生成当日总结。

description.en: Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable…
description.zh: 一个截图工具，外加两个默认关闭的自动截图时机。需要模型支持图片输入。

description.en: WeChat-style screenshot: freeze the desktop, drag a region or click a window, and the crop lands in the composer. A Windows-only fork of Durandalw/dsh-plugin-sc…
description.zh: 微信式截图：点一下冻结桌面，框选区域或单击窗口，截图直接进输入框。Windows 专用的 Durandalw/dsh-plugin-screenshot 衍生版，请勿与原版同时安装。

description.en: Skips offscreen chat and trajectory rows so long sessions scroll smoothly; measured row heights keep the scrollbar steady, visible content unchanged.
description.zh: 让视口外的聊天行与轨迹行不参与渲染，长会话滚动更稳；行高按实测保留，滚动条不跳，屏幕内画面不变。

description.en: SDD task progress (todos) and progress ledger (sdd/progress.md) as a right-sidebar tab bound to the current session, rendered with the official MarkdownText,…
description.zh: 在右侧边栏以当前会话为维度展示 SDD 任务进度（todos）与进度台账（sdd/progress.md），采用官方 MarkdownText 渲染，每 5 秒自动刷新。

description.en: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research…
description.zh: 提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、离线研究计划和只读诊断。

description.en: Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management,…
description.zh: 原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。

description.en: Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with…
description.zh: 可配置的原生 web_search 后端：在 DeepSeek 官方原生搜索与智谱 GLM web_search 之间切换当前生效入口，并在设置页管理搜索入口与凭证引用。

description.en: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with…
description.zh: 自带独立索引的侧边栏会话搜索（不再复用 DSH 官方全文索引）：一处入口在标题与内容检索间切换，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与 用户/回复/工具 类型标签；水位驱动增量同步、按归档集合清理已归档会话，整理走影子索引不阻塞在用索引。

description.en: Routes DSH web search and fetch through configured providers and records per-attempt usage and estimated costs. Requires Node.js >=22.19 and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 按已配置渠道路由 DSH 网页搜索与抓取，并记录每次尝试的用量和估算费用。需 Node.js >=22.19 与 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: One-click search-engine switcher beside the DeepSeek Harness model picker; changes the dsh-free-search provider, handy on overseas university networks that…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁一键切换搜索服务商的下拉菜单；海外大学网络常拦截 DeepSeek 官方搜索，可借此切到其他引擎规避。

description.en: SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only…
description.zh: 基于 SearXNG 的 web_search provider：通过自建实例的 JSON API 实现免费、免密钥的元搜索，附仅绑定回环地址的 docker-compose 示例。

description.en: Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard: rewrites access keys, bearer tokens, and private key blocks into `[REDACTED:<category>]` placeholders before they reach…
description.zh: 不可逆密钥脱敏守护：在访问密钥、Bearer 令牌、私钥块进入会话日志和模型请求之前，将其改写为 `[REDACTED:<category>]` 占位符。

description.en: Read-only security and compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and a local configuration audit with…
description.zh: DSH 只读安全合规插件：提示注入检测、中文 PII 脱敏、本机配置安全审计，输出脱敏且可复现的报告。

description.en: Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls,…
description.zh: dsh 安全守卫插件：基于规则的静态扫描覆盖恶意代码、提示词注入与令牌浪费，运行时拦截危险工具调用，提供 /scan 命令、plugin_scan 工具、Web 面板与白名单。

description.en: Select text in the dsh web conversation to attach it as an annotation to your next message. The source text keeps a dashed highlight with an ordinal badge in…
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页版对话里划词，把选中文本作为批注附到下一条消息。原文位置保留虚线高亮和序号角标，输入框上方的批注摘要可查看、编辑并跳回每一条批注。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app and read the translation in an always-on-top card next to the cursor: streaming text follows the newest line, up to 15000…
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，鼠标旁弹出只含译文的置顶卡片；译文流式出现并跟随最新一行，单次上限 15000 字。仅 Windows。

description.en: Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer…
description.zh: Cursor 与 GitHub PR Review 风格划词引用与批注插件：支持划词一键引用到对话（⌘L）、行内展开写批注（⇧⌘L）及输入框上方批注汇总栏一键插入。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to selected text in the Harness Web UI that replaces it with a Simplified Chinese translation in place, and restores the original on a…
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 中为选中文字添加右键翻译菜单，可就地替换为简体中文译文，再次右键还原原文。

description.en: Holds every final answer before delivery, has one independent minimal-context model call re-derive and check it, and releases only the verified text; the draft…
description.zh: 在最终回答送达前先扣住，交给一次独立、最小上下文的模型调用重新推导并校验，只放出校验后的文本，用户看不到草稿。被复核的回答多一次模型请求，文字出现前会多几秒。

description.en: One versioned vocabulary of a project's business concepts, a read-only drift scan, and the same naming rules in every agent prompt.
description.zh: 一份按项目维护的业务概念词表、只读命名漂移扫描，以及注入每个 Agent 提示的同一套命名规则。

description.en: Semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: registers two native tools, semble_search (find code by describing its behaviour, returning ranked file:line hits)…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的语义代码搜索：注册 semble_search（按行为描述检索代码，返回按相关度排序的 file:line 命中）与 semble_find_related（查找已知位置的相邻代码）两个原生工具，检索由 uvx 启动的 Semble CLI…

description.en: Brings SenseNova (日日新) models into dsh with a per-key rotation pool: paste any number of API keys and requests rotate across them, a 429 rate-limit immediately…
description.zh: 把商汤日日新（SenseNova）模型接入 dsh，并提供按 Key 轮换的 Key 池：粘贴任意多把 API Key，请求在多把 Key 之间轮转；遇 429 限流立即换下一把 Key 重试，每把 Key 独立指数退避冷却；本地 RPM 预限流从源头避开限流，池子耗尽时回报 503 与 Retry-After，使…

description.en: Beta 0.2.0-beta.2 for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only, for Host-owner use. Search original user and assistant text in the current session or same-directory workspace, with…
description.zh: 0.2.0-beta.2 仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，面向宿主所有者使用。在当前会话或同目录工作区搜索用户与助手原文，查看来源坐标和上下文；不支持非所有者身份的会话级授权。

description.en: Sensitive-character replacement for DeepSeek Harness: matches messages and tool results against a YAML blocklist you maintain (global, per provider id, or per…
description.zh: 在模型读取内容之前，按用户维护的 YAML 屏蔽表（全局 / 按 Provider ID / 按模型）替换消息与工具结果中的敏感字符，出网前再清洗一次请求，避免 DeepSeek 官方 API 的 Content Exists Risk 400。

description.en: Ten interoceptive senses for a DSH agent: workspace pulse, time, affect, needs, expression, silence, residue, open loops, body and face — deterministic state…
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体的十种内感受：房子脉搏、时间、情绪、需求、表达、沉默、余味、未闭合的事、身体与表情——各自持续演进的确定性状态。

description.en: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed…
description.zh: 面向 Sentry 的只读工具：项目列表、组织或项目范围的议题搜索、单个议题详情，以及最新或指定 event 的裁剪后堆栈。局部变量、请求头与请求体、查询字符串、依赖清单以及疑似机密的 tag 会在 event 交给模型前移除；超大 event 会依次降级源码上下文、面包屑与栈帧，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Sentry for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Sentry MCP server, a result card, and an issue panel with resolve, ignore and assign.
description.zh: 把 Sentry 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Sentry MCP 服务器的工具、结果卡片，以及可解决、忽略与指派的问题面板。

description.en: Complementary web-search provider: every web_search merges the DeepSeek Search API (primary) with serper.dev Google results (secondary) at a fixed 2:1 ratio.…
description.zh: 互补式网页搜索 provider：每次 web_search 由 DeepSeek 官方 Search API（主）与 serper.dev 的 Google 结果（补）按固定 2:1 交错合并。两路均为直连检索、无辅助模型调用；来源按 URL 去重，官方长摘要截断注入，单路超时自动降级到另一路。

description.en: Server card dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and latency, with one-click xterm.js SSH terminals; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a…
description.zh: DSH 服务器卡片仪表盘：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU、内存、磁盘与延迟，点卡片进入 xterm.js SSH 终端；支持导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧抽屉。

description.en: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent…
description.zh: 回合结束时向 Server酱3 推送微信通知——标题、模型、项目目录、Git 分支、状态与回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，fire-and-forget 不阻塞主流程。

description.en: Unofficial host-side ServerChan notifications for DeepSeek Harness: sends mobile alerts through WeChat (ServerChan Turbo) or the ServerChan³ app when…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 Server酱通知插件：在主机端监控审批、计划评审和问答，超过设定时间仍未处理时通过微信（Server酱 Turbo）或 Server酱³ App 发送手机提醒，无需保持浏览器打开。

description.en: Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe…
description.zh: 通过 `dsh --profile ctl` 管理 DSH 服务：systemd 生命周期（安装、启停、重启、自启、卸载）、持久化配置、健康探测与日志，附带 shell 补全与自更新。

description.en: Monitor the account balance for 3rd-party services those AI agents often use, such as Tavily, SerpAPI, Firecrawl, Bocha, Tinyfish, etc. Optionally you can…
description.zh: 监控 AI Agents 常用的第三方服务余额，如 Tavily、SerpAPI、Firecrawl、博查、Tinyfish 等。可选支持将服务的余额注入 System Prompt，以便 Agent 合理使用相关服务。

description.en: Exposes any local service on a LAN address and a public cloudflared quick-tunnel domain behind one password login, with per-route open/block gates managed from…
description.zh: 把一个口令登录的内网地址与公网 cloudflared 快速隧道域名提供给本机任意服务，每条路由的开放/屏蔽闸门在插件设置页里管理。需本机有 Python 3 与 cloudflared，缺失或路径填错会在启动前的设置页里提示；内网与本机访问默认免密，公网隧道需要口令。

description.en: Sidebar conversation actions: open the row menu on right-click, rename by double-click, copy the session id, and delete a conversation together with its…
description.zh: 侧边栏会话操作：右键打开行菜单、双击重命名、复制会话 ID，以及二次确认后连同存储一起删除会话。

description.en: Desktop notification and sound when a turn completes, the agent asks a question, or an approval is requested, each independently toggleable, plus an activity…
description.zh: 跑完 / 提问 / 需要审批时弹桌面通知与提示音（三类可分别开关），另附活动悬浮球，点会话行直接跳回该会话。

description.en: Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any…
description.zh: 会话桥：让当前 agent 直接用提示词驱动其它真实的 DSH 会话——跨工作区创建主会话、向任意会话发消息或注入 steering、等待并逐段读取回复（含思维链）、恢复离线会话、按名称或 id 跨工作区查找会话；还能用后台看门狗监控并调度主任务（卡住催办、偏离纠偏、卡死终止），一键归档会话。

description.en: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category…
description.zh: 为 Web 侧边栏添加按 Workspace 隔离的分类树，支持嵌套分类、拖拽归类会话、在分类中新建会话，以及删除分类时归档其中的会话。

description.en: Adds a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, behind a confirmation dialog that reports the log size, running turns, subagents,…
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中增加「永久删除会话」的操作，并附带确认对话框：对话框会说明会话日志大小，以及与该会话绑定的进行中轮次、子代理、后台任务和提醒；删除后 id 会从 live、归档与工作区登记中一并释放，因此刷新列表时该行不会复活。

description.en: Right-click any session row in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to color-tag it with a default red, ten palette colors or a custom picker, persisted locally.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话行加右键标色：默认红色、十色色板与自定义取色，颜色本地持久化。

description.en: Colors each DSH sidebar session title by state: unread (blue while the model is running, green once it has finished) and pinned (yellow, read from DSH's own…
description.zh: 按状态给 DSH 侧栏会话标题上色：未读（模型运行中＝蓝、已跑完＝绿）与置顶（黄，读取 DSH 官方置顶集合），两者合成一条从左到右的渐变。置顶、归档与排序由 DSH 官方提供，本插件不重复实现置顶、也不改写官方 bundle；另含列出全部未读会话的设置分节。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive/restore, batch & conditional delete, AI auto-rename, interrupted-session auto-resume, workspace grouping, undo last…
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强：归档/恢复、批量与条件删除、AI 自动重命名、中断自动续跑、按工作区分组、撤回最后一条消息、三类损坏日志修复（seq-gap/EIO/双格式）、价值分析与全文搜索——另含方案/收尾模板注入（系统提示词 + 上下文）。

description.en: Injects a small continuity pointer at the start of a new session, naming the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary…
description.zh: 新会话开始时注入一条很小的接续指针，说明上一个会话是谁、工作区有没有交接文档；没有交接文档时复用 DSH 已有的压缩摘要。

description.en: Add one session-header button to copy the session deep link, the full conversation as Markdown, or the working directory.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加一个复制按钮，可复制会话深度链接、整段对话 Markdown 或工作目录。

description.en: Codex-style sidebar: a pinned band for projects and conversations, collapsible 置顶/项目/组件 sections, a bell activity view of recently used conversations, and…
description.zh: Codex 风格侧边栏：项目和对话共用的置顶区、置顶/项目/组件 三段可折叠分区、小铃铛活动视图（含最后一条回答的预览）、可为每个项目换 Emoji 图标。

description.en: Cross-session messaging: sends text into another session in the same workspace, and creates new top-level sessions.
description.zh: 跨会话投递：往同工作区的另一个会话发消息，并可新建顶层会话。

description.en: Drag a session onto another workspace in the DSH sidebar and it really moves: the session-log header cwd is rewritten and the log directory is re-homed under…
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏把会话拖到别的工作区，归属真的会变：改写会话日志 header 的 cwd 并把日志目录迁到目标项目下，迁移过程中显示进度条。

description.en: Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the…
description.zh: 按官方状态给 DSH 侧栏会话行染色，配色取自福音战士：等你处理的会话为蓝色左轨，主视图打开的那条为红色左轨，已结束但未查看为紫色左轨，置顶行的标题为静态彩虹。左侧轨道按模式分档——暗档保留原色，亮档换成对浅底 ≥4.5:1 的压暗变体——分档读的是 DSH 自己的暗色标记；未读的紫色轨道两种模式共用。只读取官方…

description.en: Retrospective agent-session evaluation: deterministic grade cards and cross-session regression diffs from persisted logs — no benchmark runs, no LLM judges.
description.zh: 回溯式会话评估：从持久化日志生成确定性成绩卡与跨会话回归对比——不跑基准、不用 LLM 裁判。

description.en: Session evidence reports: /transcript writes styled HTML / Markdown / JSON reports from canonical logs, /stats prints a terminal stats card, /archive writes…
description.zh: 会话证据报告：/transcript 从权威日志生成 HTML/Markdown/JSON 报告，/stats 输出终端统计卡，/archive 打包单会话 ZIP。

description.en: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool…
description.zh: 会话内 Ctrl+F 全文查找（读会话 store 而非 DOM）：命中按来源分类（你/助手/思考/工具调用/工具输出/系统）、按轮次分组、同文合并，可切「只搜正文 / 搜全部内容」，支持正则/大小写/全词，全量高亮，并能把结果复制或导出为 Markdown。

description.en: Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native…
description.zh: 跨会话档案柜：总览工作台、折叠时间线、子代理血缘、全文检索、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪。会话流标签页嵌入原生会话页：轮次悬浮条、详情并入右栏（实时模式，切换会话可钉住原会话直播）、会话重命名（对齐官方即时同步）、结论摘要行、健康监控与常驻头部胶囊（空闲 / 活跃 / 工具执行 / 疑似卡死四态）。dsh…

description.en: One-level session folders for the web sidebar - group sessions per workspace, move them by drag-and-drop or context menu, archive and restore, server-side…
description.zh: 为网页侧边栏提供单层会话文件夹——按工作区分组会话，支持拖拽或右键菜单移动、归档与恢复，数据在服务端持久化。

description.en: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.
description.zh: 高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停（全局）+ 会话级冻结/恢复 + 后端自动重试；错峰自动续跑。

description.en: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename), keyboard model…
description.zh: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、Alt+M 键盘切换模型与备用发送、Esc 焦点交接，Alt+W 关闭/恢复 dsh-split-screen 工作区；键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。已适配…

description.en: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row…
description.zh: 侧边栏会话标题图标：标题生成时用同一路由的辅助模型调用画一枚 24×24 单色 SVG 隐喻图标，显示在每行标题左侧，带磁盘缓存。

description.en: Adds an Inherit row to the session menu: mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent failures, commands, todos)…
description.zh: 会话菜单新增「继承」：把长会话里的具体锚点（任务原文、最近的用户指令、改过的文件、最近的失败、命令、待办）机械提取成交接单，在干净的新会话里接着干——预设默认一并继承，不复制历史，也不调用模型。

description.en: See how you have been using AI: `/session-insights` reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results…
description.zh: 回头看看你是怎么使用 AI 的：`/session-insights` 会整理一段时间内的 DSH 会话，找出哪些做法有效、哪些问题总在重复、最终真正留下了哪些成果，并生成一份保存在本机的复盘报告。

description.en: Session board in the left sidebar: every chat session's current work, todos and progress, with a searchable overview heatmap and one-click navigation back to…
description.zh: 在左侧栏提供会话看板：集中展示每个会话的当前工作、待办与进度，附带可搜索的概览热力图，点击卡片即可跳回会话。

description.en: A session manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: per-workspace category trees with drag-and-drop ordering, pinned sessions hoisted above the categories (or…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的会话管理插件：按工作区划分的分类树，支持拖拽排序；置顶会话可抬到分类上方，也可按开关留在所属分类内；另有归档分区，以及删除回收站——删掉的会话日志留存，可恢复或批量彻底清除。宿主半边掌管分类与回收站数据，网页半边负责渲染，两者作为一个插件一起发布。本插件是…

description.en: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of…
description.zh: 让浏览器最近用过的会话保持常驻：切走再切回来直接复用已加载的历史、不再重新读取；常驻数量可配置，并可整体关闭。

description.en: Purges billion-context snapshots left behind after a session is deleted in DeepSeek Harness, and can also clean up cost-meter ledger rows (off by default).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中删除会话后，清理 billion-context 快照；cost-meter 账本记录的清理默认关闭，可在设置里打开。

description.en: Session insights and one-click shareable HTML replay for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话洞察，并可一键导出为可分享的 HTML 回放。

description.en: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
description.zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness session and workspace manager —— Workspaces: archive and visibility. Sessions: move, migrate presets, delete, favorite, review later,…
description.zh: DSH 会话与工作区管理——工作区：归档与显示。会话：跨工作区移动、预设迁移、删除；收藏、待回看、优先级、标签、备注。批量操作。

description.en: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus…
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的会话右键菜单补上标记未读、复制会话信息、在访达中显示或换 IDE 打开、永久删除（连子会话一起删），并给会话行加上报错与未读状态点、悬浮卡信息、归档行的一键删除，以及一个可逐项开关菜单的设置面板；界面提供中英文两套文案。

description.en: Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中跨工作区移动、归档、恢复、可携式备份/导出与导入会话。

description.en: Cross-version session migration for DSH: sweeps legacy session stores (v0 plaintext, .zstd and .zip exports), re-pins the header cwd to the target workspace…
description.zh: DSH 会话跨版本迁移：扫描旧版会话目录（v0 明文、.zstd 与 .zip 导出包），改写 header cwd 绑定目标工作区并落盘，打开会话时由持久化层自动完成版本升级；设置侧边栏（环境 / 导入 / 列表 / 转换）加 CLI（check / fix / import）。

description.en: One Settings page for every DeepSeek Harness session: browse active and archived sessions by workspace, generate a title from the whole conversation for live…
description.zh: 在设置里管理全部 DeepSeek Harness 会话：按工作区分组浏览活跃与已归档会话，为活跃或已归档会话按整段对话生成标题，归档/恢复，把冷会话移动到其他工作区，并在确认后彻底删除已归档会话（含其子代理会话）。

description.en: Manage DSH sessions the way Windows Explorer manages files: folder tree, tags, notes, recycle bin. Folders, tags and notes live in a separate index; deleting a…
description.zh: 像 Windows 资源管理器那样管理 DSH 的会话：目录树、标签、备注、回收站。文件夹、标签、备注存在独立索引里；删除会话会把其目录移入插件回收站，跨工作区剪切会移动会话文件并改写其 cwd。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH Web sessions: browser notifications plus Windows toast when a session finishes, fails, needs an approval, or asks a question.…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话提供桌面通知：会话完成、失败、需要审批或提问时发送浏览器通知，在 Windows/WSL 下同时弹出系统 Toast；点击通知定位到对应会话（浏览器通知聚焦已打开标签页，Toast 新开标签页）。

description.en: Copies a session log path (or a paste-ready handoff block) and turns the multi-frame zstd log into a readable file another session can continue from.
description.zh: 复制会话日志路径（或可直接粘贴的接续块），并把多帧 zstd 会话日志转成可读文件，供另一个会话读取接续。

description.en: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin…
description.zh: 把会话与工作区置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：行级图钉与换色、会话头开关、已置顶面板；0.4.0 再加导航组织器——Pin 分组（boards）、标签与保存视图、会话健康摘要与 /goto。

description.en: Sidebar archive directory for DSH Web: restore a session to its original workspace slot, delete the session log, or edit-and-branch a user message into a new…
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏归档目录：将会话恢复到原工作区槽位、删除会话日志，或从用户消息修改并分支为新会话。

description.en: Export a session as a ZIP archive with its attachments, and import such an archive as a new standalone session in the current workspace.
description.zh: 把会话连同附件导出为压缩包，或把这样的压缩包导入为当前工作区里的新会话。

description.en: Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, blocked ⏸️, review 👀, done ✅, plan…
description.zh: 基于 Jev 决策模型或 Agent 工具为会话自动分类，并将任务阶段直观展示为标题前缀 Emoji（进行中 🚧、阻塞 ⏸️、待验收 👀、已完成 ✅、规划 💡、排障 🐛）。支持生命周期状态自愈、可选 Jev 决策推断（需配置 Jev API Key）、Agent 自主标记与可视化设置面板。

description.en: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a…
description.zh: 全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。

description.en: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step…
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏的未读、待办与状态读数中枢：铃铛按顺序定位未读会话，快捷键依次走到正在等你输入的会话，⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. 在访问过的对话之间前后切换；另有总览把未读与待决策会话分两区铺开；底部一行六项会话状态读数，每个图标都能点，点了跳到下一个同类会话；账本落在 host…

description.en: Progress tab for the DSH right sidebar: the turn status of the session and the progress long-running tasks reported, in one tab beside the conversation.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的进度页：会话每一轮的状态与长任务上报的进度集中在一个 tab 里，和对话并排看。

description.en: Live CNY cost of the current session under the composer, priced per assistant message by the model that produced it and the peak or off-peak window of its own…
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示当前会话的人民币费用，每条消息按其自身时间戳与该条所用模型的峰谷单价计价；设置页可编辑每个模型的六项单价，未定价的模型按 Flash 单价估算并以 ~ 标注。

description.en: Deterministic cross-session transcript retrieval: the `recall` tool searches past session logs with explicit scope control.
description.zh: 确定性跨会话检索：`recall` 工具带显式范围控制地搜索历史会话日志。

description.en: Recycle bin for DSH sessions: sidebar delete icons, multi-select restore and permanent delete, live-session protection.
description.zh: DSH 会话回收站：侧边栏删除图标、多选还原与彻底删除、活跃会话保护。

description.en: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the…
description.zh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

description.en: Adds Delete conversation and Batch delete to the sidebar session menu; a deleted conversation and its subagent sessions are moved to the Windows recycle bin,…
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行菜单中增加「删除对话」与「批量删除」；删除的对话及其子代理会话移入 Windows 回收站，可从回收站还原。

description.en: Adds a session_rename tool so an AI can retitle the DeepSeek Harness session it is running in.
description.zh: 新增 session_rename 工具，让 AI 能重命名自己所在的 DSH 会话。

description.en: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit…
description.zh: 诊断并安全修复损坏的 DSH 会话历史：raw zstd/JSONL 校验、tool-call ID 修复、单槽 pre-repair 备份与恢复、审计记录。

description.en: After official llm-retry (n/5) gives up, keep retrying transient API failures (timeout, transport, rate-limit, 5xx, dropped SSE) on the same open step until…
description.zh: 官方 llm-retry（n/5）耗尽后，对超时/传输/限流/5xx/SSE 断流等瞬时失败在同一打开 step 上继续重试直到成功、取消或暂停；认证失败、额度耗尽和用户停止不会重试。

description.en: Saves a whole DSH session as one .dsproj project file and opens it back. The session header gains an open button, a save button, a save-as button and an…
description.zh: 把整个 DSH 会话存成单个 .dsproj 工程文件，并能再打开回来。会话标题栏上多了打开、保存、另存为三个按钮和自动保存开关，空会话页面另有自己的打开入口。第一次保存会问存到哪里，之后一键覆盖；打开 .dsproj 会导入该会话并切过去，按需可以把包里的工作区记忆合并回本机。

description.en: Per-session status labels (built-in active/done/paused plus custom) shown in the sidebar, conversation header, and hover card, with editable colors.
description.zh: 为每个会话设置项目状态标签（内置进行中/已结项/搁置中+自定义标签，颜色可调），在侧栏、对话头部与悬停卡片中显示。

description.en: Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256…
description.zh: 会话清道夫：在 DSH 设置中扫描、查看并安全清理本机 AI 终端会话历史（Claude Code、Codex CLI、WorkBuddy、DSH），隔离优先、带 SHA-256 清单与一键整批恢复，彻底删除需输入确认短语。

description.en: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness — syncs sessions and settings between machines through git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备会话同步：经 git 在多机之间同步会话与设置。

description.en: Copy session IDs, send messages to live or saved sessions, and view session token usage.
description.zh: 复制会话 ID、向在线或已保存的会话发送消息，并查看会话 token 用量。

description.en: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a…
description.zh: 打开页面时左侧边栏直接显示每个会话的主题，无需点进会话。启动时预热会话投影缓存，让冷会话也能显示真实标题。

description.en: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click…
description.zh: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

description.en: Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the…
description.zh: 把 dsh 会话标题统一成「日期｜类型｜主题」（类型与主题由模型对整段对话总结），并支持可逆的会话隐藏：暂时不用的会话从侧边栏收起，不删除、随时一键显示回来。

description.en: Adds a manual, confirm-first title generator: a header button and a session-row menu entry ask a model to summarize the whole conversation, show the proposal…
description.zh: 手动触发的「先确认再改名」标题生成器：顶栏按钮与会话行菜单各一个入口，让模型总结整段会话给出标题，在可编辑弹窗里确认后才重命名会话；不注册标题 provider，不影响自带的自动标题。

description.en: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session…
description.zh: 整合工具包：会话身份、全局/工作区提示词（含引用文件）、会话自动上线、免 UAC 网页重启、会话间消息。

description.en: Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).
description.zh: 会话工作台：全文搜索历史会话、一键 @引用 召回最多 3 个，并管理会话视图标签栏（显示/隐藏 + 拖拽排序）。

description.en: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop…
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强插件 - 工作区会话数展示、归档会话面板（支持恢复/删除）、拖拽移动会话到其他工作区。

description.en: Archive, restore, permanently delete, and move DeepSeek Harness sessions across workspaces from one unified settings panel.
description.zh: 在统一设置面板中归档、恢复、彻底删除并跨工作区移动 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: Model switching and reasoning-effort control for DeepSeek Harness: set_model and list_models agent tools let the agent autonomously change its provider, model…
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供动态模型切换与思考深度调节：set_model / list_models 两个 Agent 工具让模型按任务难度自主切换 provider、model 与 reasoningEffort（思考深度），强制附带切换理由，带 Provider 白名单与上下文窗口 Token…

description.en: Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages…
description.zh: 将 DSH 设置界面归一为同一套设计语言：统一各设置页的排版、卡片、控件、焦点与动效，包括其他插件贡献的页面。

description.en: Moves and resizes the DeepSeek Harness settings panel; its position and size are remembered per browser.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的设置面板可以自由拖动与缩放，位置与尺寸按浏览器记忆。

description.en: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop…
description.zh: 统一收纳 DeepSeek Harness 里的第三方插件设置：自动发现、分组，并在一个可折叠的导航入口下拖拽排序。

description.en: Adds edit mode to the DSH settings nav for drag-reordering, per-section show/hide and named collapsible drawer grouping saved in the plugin's own settings…
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页导航加编辑模式：拖拽排序、逐个显隐、用命名可折叠抽屉分组，排版存在插件自己的设置命名空间；还能把最多 5 个分区钉到主界面侧栏，一键直达。

description.en: Reorder the settings panel nav by long-pressing and dragging a section: the dragged row turns translucent and follows the pointer, the order is saved to the…
description.zh: 长按拖动即可重排设置面板左侧大项：被拖项半透明并跟随指针，顺序保存在插件自己的目录而非 settings.yaml，卸载后自动恢复官方原序。

description.en: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto…

description.en: Web mascot that acts out each live tool call (read, write, edit, search, run, plan, sub-agent, wait, error) with matching step cards in chat; ships two…

description.en: Ranks this DeepSeek Harness profile's installed, disabled and marketplace plugins for the task at hand, and prints the exact next step for each — enable,…

description.en: Task reliability: auto-retry on model timeouts/failures, auto-continue unfinished tasks, completion verification, thinking-repeat interruption, resume after…

description.en: Task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: durable per-repo manifest, worktree mode injects a creation instruction with your first message under an automatic worktree/…

description.en: Wraps work in named tasks and, once a task closes, folds its whole span of messages into one summary at the next step boundary; the original content can be…

description.en: Turn-level workspace undo for Git worktrees: every agent turn gets a private snapshot, /undo previews a red/green diff card that is confirmed in place, files…

description.en: Adjust Agent Team's member count, task count, message size and teardown timeout.

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install…

description.en: Plain-language trust dashboard for the dsh trust family: aggregates the nine channels (injection interception, write denials, egress blocks, custody-chain…
description.zh: 信任面板：把 dsh 信任插件族九个通道（注入拦截、写拒绝、出网拦截、custody 链校验、工具面/系统提示词漂移、残留扫描、压缩遗忘约束、profile 组成）聚合成右侧栏一块仪表盘——一个状态灯 + 事件卡片，把引擎术语翻译成非安全背景用户能看懂并知道要不要处理的句子；read/egress 引擎随包自带…

description.en: Mounts the tsm-core-dlr semantic service (LanceDB vectors + graph) as MCP tools and ships the scenario-independent DLR/TSM modeling skill, a service-status…
description.zh: 把 tsm-core-dlr 语义服务（LanceDB 向量 + 图）挂为 MCP 工具，并携带与场景无关的 DLR/TSM 建模技能、服务状态浮层与 agent 规则；该服务是硬依赖，须先运行、bundle 才能激活。

description.en: Per-turn and per-session estimated cost in the DSH Web UI, computed from provider-reported token usage in four buckets with the built-in official DeepSeek CNY…

description.en: Delete a complete closed turn (question + answer + tool calls) from a DeepSeek Harness session, without deleting the session.
description.zh: 删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的一整轮对话（提问 + 回答 + 工具调用），不影响会话本身。

description.en: Turn-finished music reminder: when an agent turn ends, play a ringtone or any local audio file (bundled synthesised telephone ring, custom absolute path, or an…
description.zh: 回合提醒音乐：对话（回合）结束时播放铃声或任意本地音频提醒你回来——内置合成的电话「叮铃铃」，也可填宿主机绝对路径或直接在设置页上传；右下角浮标可暂停/继续/关闭，默认循环响到你手动停；设置项在「设置 → 内置插件」里，部署级默认值可写进 cordis.patch.yml。

description.en: Adds a sidebar tab that folds a session into user turns (input, tool steps, output) with one-click jump back into the conversation.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按用户轮次折叠会话（输入、工具步骤、输出），一键跳回对话原位。

description.en: Shows what each completed turn cost in CNY on its own row under the turn, with a click-to-open breakdown naming the tokens per category, the unit rate, the…
description.zh: 在每个已完成回合的下方单独一行显示这一轮的花费金额（人民币），点击展开明细，列出各 token 类别的数量、单价、命中的价格规则与计费时刻；单价可在 DSH 设置页里按模型维护，含四类 token 单价、每周循环的峰谷规则（系数自定）与绝对时间区间的限时优惠价。0.2.3 起还能看账户：读取 14 家…

description.en: Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.
description.zh: Codex 风格自动隐藏右缘轮次导航：靠边浮现、单轮 tooltip、会话内搜索、长会话 30 轮滚动窗口。

description.en: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation. Ships on npm as `dsh-turn-scrubber`.
description.zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。npm 包名 `dsh-turn-scrubber`。

description.en: Per-turn and per-step cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: a Turns tab beside Chat and Trajectory with tokens, estimated cost, cache savings, and an inspector for…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的逐轮、逐步成本账本：在 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁新增 Turns 页签，显示 token、估算费用、缓存节省，以及工具参数、原始返回与来源检查器。纯客户端，价格按已记录的模型用量估算。

description.en: Video-style turn navigation for the Web UI: full-map progress bar with hover preview cards (tools/files/tokens), drag scrub, ⌘K in-conversation search, ⌘↑/⌘↓…
description.zh: 会话内轮次导航视频进度条：全图分段、悬停富元信息卡（工具/文件/token）、拖动 scrub、⌘K 全会话搜索、⌘↑/⌘↓ 逐轮跳转、Esc 返回原位——基于会话事件日志，超出已加载窗口仍可用。

description.en: Zero-config per-turn git checkpoints: after every completed agent turn in a git workspace, stages all changes into one tagged [turnsnap] commit (serialized…
description.zh: 零配置的逐轮 git 检查点：在 git 工作区的每个 agent 轮结束后，把全部变更暂存为一条带 [turnsnap] 标记的提交（串行队列、感知沙箱策略），每一轮都是回滚点。

description.en: Study companion for your materials with guided practice, evidence-grounded feedback, Leitner spaced review, 18 teacher tools, and a Chinese/English student…
description.zh: 面向自选资料的学习陪练，使用当前 DSH 会话模型，提供引导练习、证据反馈、Leitner 间隔复习、18 个教师工具与中英双语学生面板；要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Python 3.11+ 及 Python 运行时依赖。

description.en: Replaces the terminal tool on Windows with Git Bash.
description.zh: 可将 Windows 环境下的终端工具替换为 Git Bash

description.en: Recalls prompts sent earlier in the current session with the up and down keys in an empty composer, and shows a position badge while browsing.
description.zh: 在空输入框里用 ↑/↓ 翻出本会话之前发过的提示词，翻动时显示位置角标。

description.en: Continues numbered and bulleted lists in the DSH composer, so Shift+Enter after "1. item" starts a new line with the next marker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里写列表时，Shift+Enter 换行后自动补上下一个编号（1. → 2.）或项目符号。

description.en: A WYSIWYG Typst editor for papers, reports, exams, resumes, charts, posters, sheet music, and slides exported as PPTX.
description.zh: Typst 文档编辑工具：WYSIWYG 编辑排版论文、报告、试卷、简历、图表、海报、乐谱和可导出为 PPTX 的 Slides。

description.en: Wallpaper-aware readability repair for the DSH Web GUI: it lifts the three low-contrast secondary text tokens with color-mix plus an adjustable text halo, adds…
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的「壁纸感知」可读性修复：用 color-mix 把三个低对比次级文字 token 向主文字靠拢，并叠加可调强度的文字光晕；提供仅作用于会话 Markdown 的内容规则（链接加粗 / 常驻下划线 / 变色、标题与正文变色）、可调的彩虹描边与渐变填充标题特效、从插件目录或 DSH_HOME…

description.en: Registers the TypeSafe/Jev (System One) skill into DeepSeek Harness's global skill layer, so every session can classify, route, score, extract and gate on…
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe / Jev（System One 判断模型）的构建技能注册进 DeepSeek Harness 的全局技能层，让每个会话都能用带类型的判断做分类、路由、打分、抽取和置信度门控，取代「调大模型再解析回复」。不含任何密钥，API key 由使用者通过 OPENROUTER_API_KEY 提供。

description.en: Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the…
description.zh: 把流式输出的助手回复变成短促音效：按可调的最小间隔逐字发声，只对回复正文发声，窗口最小化、被遮挡或切到后台标签页时照常发声。内置两种音色，也可自调波形，或载入音频文件当音色。

description.en: Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with…
