description.en: Appearance customization for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, wallpaper and video backgrounds, translucency and glassmorphism.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观自定义:主题调色、壁纸与视频背景、半透明与毛玻璃。

description.en: Authentication gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the login gate covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing with…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 认证网关：登录门禁覆盖页面、/api、/plugins 与 WebSocket 升级；PBKDF2 口令哈希（每用户独立盐）、HttpOnly SameSite 会话 Cookie（名字按 DSH_HOME 唯一）、按源 IP 登录锁定；邀请码注册；两步验证可用…

description.en: Requires the ui-ux-pro-max design skill to be installed; this plugin only gates it. Adds a switch to the DSH sidebar footer that enables or disables the…

description.en: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace…
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面化 UI 增强：自适应对比度壁纸、带活动流与投喂玩法的桌面宠物、@file 工作区文件引用，以及可缩放的文件/预览右侧面板。

description.en: A lightweight appearance skin for DeepSeek Harness: custom wallpaper, glass-like panel transparency, and an accent color; server-side settings shared across…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 轻量级外观皮肤：自定义壁纸、玻璃质感面板与重点色；服务端持久化、多设备一致，不接管原生深浅色。

description.en: File-based CSS overrides for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — edit ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css and reload to restyle any plugin's elements, for example making the…
description.zh: 基于本地 CSS 文件的界面覆盖——编辑 ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css 并刷新，即可改任意插件元素的外观，例如让引用浮层完全不透明。

description.en: Scales the whole DeepSeek Harness interface from 50% to 200%, menus and pop-ups included, set from Settings - General with a slider, a percent field or…
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 整个界面（包括菜单和弹窗）缩放到 50% 至 200%，在「设置 - 通用设置」中用滑块、百分比输入或预设调整。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用，桌面应用本身没有缩放功能。

description.en: Per-region UI zoom for DeepSeek Harness — Ctrl + wheel sets independent zoom levels for the conversation header, the left sidebar, the conversation body and…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分区域缩放：Ctrl + 滚轮分别为会话顶栏、左侧栏、会话正文和右侧面板设置独立比例（侧栏 25%–300%）；拖动顶栏整条下边界可以把它调矮或调高，调高只增加高度、字大小不变。

description.en: Multi-agent workflow for math-modeling contests: the "UltraMath" preset runs a problem from reading through framework, derivation, coding, verification, paper…
description.zh: 数学建模竞赛多 Agent 求解工作流：「UltraMath」主控预设一个预设跑通 读题→框架→推导→编码→验算→论文→审稿 全流程，另有 数学家/工程师/作家/审稿人 4 个单阶段角色预设与 33 篇模型库技能文档。

description.en: Umbrella Corporation theme for DeepSeek Harness with dark and light schemes, a spinning umbrella watermark and a HUD frame.
description.zh: 生化危机保护伞公司主题，提供明暗双外观、自转保护伞水印与 HUD 装饰。

description.en: Lists archived sessions, previews their content, restores them to the original workspace, and adds an optional archive confirmation.
description.zh: 列出已归档会话、预览内容、恢复到原工作区，并提供可选的归档二次确认。

description.en: Conversation and workspace undo: use the /undo timeline, session-header action, or message icon to roll back before any sent prompt; private Shadow Git…
description.zh: 对话与工作区撤销：通过 /undo 节点轴、会话头部按钮或消息下方图标回滚到任意已发送 prompt 之前；插件私有 Shadow Git 快照恢复文件，被回滚回合不会进入模型上下文，误操作还能“撤回回滚”。附带归档会话管理与工具卡片分类配色。

description.en: Undo/redo & rollback system for DSH: every config change is auto-snapshotted; undo/redo/restore to any version from the WebUI or the offline CLI/GUI tools…
description.zh: DSH 撤销/回退系统：配置变更自动存档，一键撤销/恢复/回退到任意版本，支持 WebUI 与离线 CLI/GUI 工具（DSH 启动失败也能救）。

description.en: One shared Obsidian vault for every agent: dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), vault template, dsh plugin (memory_search/show/submit…
description.zh: 多 Agent 共享一个 Obsidian vault：零依赖 Python core（检索/晋升/裁决/遗忘）+ vault 模板 + dsh 插件（memory_search/show/submit/status）。

description.en: Unified plugin marketplace built for the DSH Desktop (EAC) shell, aggregating the curated catalog, the GitHub dsh-plugin ecosystem and the npm registry into…

description.en: Union web search for DSH (consolidated successor of DDDMUC/dsh-free-search, which it credits): 28 engines across three tiers — keyless free…
description.zh: DSH 的联合联网搜索（DDDMUC/dsh-free-search 的整合后继，README 有致谢）：28 个引擎分三档——免 key 免费（Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG 多实例联合，Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel 免 key…

description.en: Union workspaces: merge multiple directories into one session, manage unions from a settings panel, and read/write member files via uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_…
description.zh: 联合工作区：将多个目录合并到一个会话中，通过设置面板管理联合工作区，使用 uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move 工具读写成员目录文件。

description.en: Unit conversion as a `convert` tool: 10 categories (length, area, volume, time, angle, speed, temperature, pressure, energy/heat, power) and 82 units with…
description.zh: 单位换算：提供 convert 工具，覆盖长度/面积/体积/时间/角度/速度/温度/压力/热量/功率十大类共 82 个单位，支持中英文单位名与温差（Δ）换算，并在 DSH Web 会话视图中提供按类别分模块、跟随中英文界面语言的「单位换算」标签页。

description.en: Give DeepSeek Harness a real office environment. Univer Office Plugin brings spreadsheets, docs, slides, canvases, relational tables, and more into one runtime…

description.en: Offline, deterministic public API catalog search for DeepSeek Harness, with Chinese and English queries plus exact filters for authentication, HTTPS, CORS,…

description.en: The desktop app has its own refresh button. Edited a plugin but a run is still going? Refresh. Window sluggish after hours of use? Refresh. One button fixes…

description.en: Composer infinity switch: while the highest reasoning effort is selected, one click appends a configurable notice to the system prompt.

description.en: Plug/unplug any DeepSeek Harness plugin cleanly — list every mounted layer (bundles + patch rows), remove with full cleanup, disable/enable without deleting,…

description.zh: 让任何会说 HTTP 的东西驱动 DSH：47 条路由（REST + SSE），覆盖工作区、会话（创建/提示、SSE 实时生成、历史、统计、任务清单、中止、问答）、模型与全局默认模型、提供方、Agent Preset、设置命名空间、技能与工作区文件（含分片续传上传），另有 OpenAI 兼容的…
